# Lexical Audit — Batch 002 (v2.10.2)

**Base:** v2.10.1  
**Target:** v2.10.2  
**Data:** 928 records / 928 stable IDs / 26 A–Z files  
**ID-set SHA-256:** `dd1705e64c8df4ad7ebca188a6ad856fff1d180d99730d2d77d2ba6fbdc12656`

## Scope and result

| Area | Operations | Coverage before | Coverage after |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| US IPA additions | 11 | 563/928 | 574/928 |
| Word Family | 9 | 122/928 | 131/928 |
| New headwords | 0 | 928 | 928 |
| Changed IDs | 0 | 928 | 928 |

### IPA records

`absence-n`, `absorb-v`, `accommodate-v`, `accountant-n`, `accounting-n`, `accurate-adj`, `activate-v`, `additional-adj`, `adequate-adj`, `adjacent-adj`, `administration-n`. All were previously blank in `phonetic.us`; values and source URLs are listed in `docs/sources/SOURCES_TOEIC_Dictionary_v2.10.2.md`.

### Word-family records

`accommodate-v`, `accommodation-n`, `accountant-n`, `accounting-n`, `administration-n`, `administrative-adj`, `administrator-n`, `annual-adj`, `annually-adv`. All linked headwords already exist; no speculative new lexemes were added.

## Guarded patching

- `patches/v2.10.2/batch-001-ipa.json`: 11 operations on `/phonetic/us`.
- `patches/v2.10.2/batch-002-word-family.json`: 9 operations on `/word_family`.
- Both patch files use `baseDataVersion=2.10.1`, `targetDataVersion=2.10.2`, the stable ID SHA-256 and `expect.old`.
- Both dry-runs passed before apply.

## Remaining data gaps

- IPA: 354/928 records still blank. Next batch should prioritize common TOEIC/General English items and must cite a reliable pronunciation source for each record.
- Word Family: 797/928 records still have an empty family list. Many records legitimately have no useful derivational family among current headwords; do not invent or add off-dictionary forms just to raise coverage.
- Synonym/antonym glossary: 312 relation terms remain without a reference gloss under the current validator statistic; next audit should resolve context/sense and glossary meaning, not copy a generic meaning across unrelated senses.
- CEFR remains editorial-estimate unless a specific sense-level source supports a change. No CEFR reclassification was made in this batch.

# TOEIC Answer Position Balance — Batch 007 / v2.17.0

Ngày: 11/11/2026

## Mục tiêu
Giảm độ lệch vị trí đáp án đúng ở Listening Part 3, Listening Part 4 và Reading Part 7 mà không thay câu hỏi, passage/transcript, đáp án đúng về mặt nội dung hay giải thích. Không dùng random shuffle.

## Kết quả phân bố
| Part | Trước v2.17.0 (A/B/C/D) | Sau v2.17.0 (A/B/C/D) | Số câu |
|---|---|---|---:|
| Listening Part 3 | 10 / 18 / 10 / 1 | 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 | 39 |
| Listening Part 4 | 9 / 12 / 7 / 2 | 8 / 8 / 7 / 7 | 30 |
| Reading Part 7 | 13 / 27 / 19 / 4 | 16 / 16 / 16 / 15 | 63 |

Phân bố được làm gần đều nhất có thể theo tổng số câu của từng Part; số lượng từng Part không thay đổi.

## Quy tắc thay đổi và bảo toàn dữ liệu
- Đúng 27 câu được điều chỉnh: Part 3 có 8, Part 4 có 5, Part 7 có 14 câu.
- Mỗi câu chỉ hoán đổi vị trí của phương án đúng với một distractor để đưa đáp án đúng về vị trí mục tiêu. Tất cả phương án và stable `choiceIds` di chuyển cùng nhau.
- Trước khi đổi, mỗi câu lưu `previousChoices`, `previousChoiceIds`, `previousAnswerIndex`, cùng `choiceOrderRevision: "2.17.0"`.
- Mapping chi tiết được lưu tại `tools/answer-position-balance-v2.17.0.json` và được kiểm thử tự động.
- Progress đã có `choiceId` được tìm lại vị trí hiện tại; progress cũ không có ID được ánh xạ từ snapshot v2.16. Chỉ số cũ được lưu thêm ở `previousChoiceIndex`.
- 12 nhóm distractor có `legacyChoices`/`legacyChoiceIds` từ v2.15 được giữ nguyên. ID lịch sử không được nhầm với ID phương án hiện tại.
- Dữ liệu có text không khớp hoặc index không hợp lệ được giữ nguyên, không tự suy đoán ID. Migration có tính idempotent.
- Không nâng IndexedDB version (vẫn DB `toeic-vocabulary-phase1`, version 1, store `workspace`), không reset tiến độ, không thay đổi 928 từ vựng, question ID hoặc thứ tự câu hỏi.

# TOEIC Content Batch 001 — v2.11.0

**Scope:** TOEIC L&R only; original editorial material; no ETS copyrighted questions/audio.

## Listening

- Added 8 Part 1 image-description practice sets, each with one image, four spoken statements, one correct answer, balanced A–D key positions (2 each) and explanation naming the actual correct letter.

- Added 4 TOEIC-focused lessons / 12 exercises.

# TOEIC Content Quality & Dashboard Layout — Batch 003 (v2.13.0)

- **Date:** 2026-11-10
- **Baseline:** v2.12.0
- **Scope:** TOEIC-only; 211-question practice pool and dashboard diagnostics presentation.
- **Non-goals:** no new question/resource IDs; no new vocabulary headwords; no IndexedDB schema change; no mock engine or IELTS content.

## Dashboard / layout

- Removed the generic `panel` class from `#toeicProgressPanel`; the diagnostics heading no longer renders as one large boxed card.
- Introduced a clearer hierarchy: `TOEIC LEARNING DIAGNOSTICS` eyebrow, `Tiến độ theo 7 Parts` H2, concise explanation and `TOEIC L&R` context label.
- Split content into Listening Parts 1–4 and Reading Parts 5–7 groups with separate labels and exam-form counts.
- Kept individual Part buttons framed and interactive; the priority recommendation is a light, left-accented note rather than another heavy card.
- Preserved local analytics calculation, click-to-filter behavior, `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`, visible keyboard focus and responsive tablet/mobile breakpoints.

## Listening edits

- All 8 Part 1 prompts now refer to an `illustration`, matching the current SVG assets and `visualType=illustration` provenance. The runtime variable and CSS frame class were also renamed from “photo” to “illustration”. The items are not described as photographs.
- Retained image-specific Vietnamese rationales that explicitly name the correct A/B/C/D option.
- Updated the Part 2 invoice-approval distractors to remove two choices that repeated the same page-two clue.
- Reworded the supplier-samples tag question and answer to make the confirmation (“They did…”) explicit instead of relying on a potentially confusing bare “Yes”.
- Made selected Part 3/4/2 explanations more complete and clearly Vietnamese; existing 38 Part 3/4 explanations previously in English remain localized.

## Reading edits

- Localized the remaining legacy English question explanations into Vietnamese, including the analyst-position question.
- Strengthened short explanations in selected Part 5, Part 6 and Part 7 questions so the learner sees the clue or grammatical reason rather than only a copied answer phrase.
- No passage, question ID, answer index or choice order was intentionally changed.

## Preservation and scope

- Vocabulary remains 928 records / 928 stable IDs / 26 A–Z files.
- Listening remains 56 units / 102 questions; Reading remains 35 resources / 109 questions; Grammar remains 25 lessons / 54 exercises.
- No personal-progress migration, local storage key or IndexedDB schema change.
- No ETS question, passage or audio is included. Browser TTS and SVG illustrations keep their existing provenance labels.

## QA gates

- `test_learning_content.py` adds checks for Vietnamese connective/explanatory wording (an accented English token alone is insufficient), Part 1 illustration labeling/rendering semantics and Part 2 invoice distractor separation.
- `test_dashboard_layout.py` adds static checks for section unboxing, hierarchy, independent Listening/Reading mount points, responsive breakpoints, keyboard focus and accessible status announcements.
- GitHub Actions now runs the dashboard layout test module too.
- Automated tests validate structure and selected editorial invariants; they do not constitute third-party proofreading or final semantic signoff of every answer.

## Archived source: `docs/batches/TOEIC_DESIGN_SYSTEM_AND_EDITORIAL_AUDIT_v2.14.0.md`

# TOEIC Design System & Editorial Evidence Batch — v2.14.0

**Ngày:** 10/11/2026  
**Baseline:** v2.13.0  
**Scope:** TOEIC-only; shared responsive design system + editorial evidence mapping.

## 1. Shared design rules

- Added `assets/css/design-system.css` after feature CSS so all pages share a common font stack, fluid type, line-height, spacing, radii, card surface, button/input/icon scale, keyboard focus and disabled-state behavior.
- System font stack uses platform fonts on iOS/iPadOS, Android, Windows and macOS; no remote font download was introduced. Body type is 15–16 px; helper text is generally 12–14 px; uppercase eyebrow labels are 11 px.
- Primary/secondary buttons and input controls target at least 44 px; phone fields use 16 px text and 46 px height to avoid iOS Safari focus zoom. Icon-only controls have accessible names and shared sizing.
- Breakpoints: phone 320–640 CSS px; compact tablet/iPad portrait 641–850; tablet landscape/small laptop 851–1199; laptop/desktop 1200+. Tablet never displays the phone bottom bar.
- Phone navigation and main-area clearance respect bottom safe-area insets; app frame uses `100svh`/`100dvh` with fallback.
- Motion is restrained: page entry, button/card feedback and progress-fill transitions only. Hover is limited to fine pointers; `prefers-reduced-motion` disables non-essential movement.
- Added contrast preference support and visible `:focus-visible` feedback.

## 2. Editorial evidence pass

- Indexed 211 correct answers across Listening (102) and Reading (109) and linked each item to source text or an explicit review category.
- Listening: 32 direct-source matches, 34 lexical-evidence pointers, 3 paraphrase/inference cases manually checked, 8 Part 1 illustration/key comparisons checked, 25 Part 2 response-fit items checked.
- Reading: 32 direct-source matches, 28 lexical-evidence pointers, 3 paraphrase/inference cases manually checked, 30 Part 5 grammar items checked, 16 Part 6 context/cohesion items checked.
- The 6 low-overlap inference items are individually noted in `TOEIC_EDITORIAL_EVIDENCE_AUDIT_v2.14.0.md`.
- The 126 direct/lexical items still need a full distractor-plausibility/uniqueness pass; source overlap does not prove all alternative choices are wrong.

## 3. Listening corrections

- Replaced all 23 generic Part 2 translation placeholders with Vietnamese translations of their actual spoken lines.
- Standardized the supplier-samples response-selection prompt to match the actual task.
- Changed the room-unavailable negative-tag response to “That’s right…” to avoid a bare “Yes” that can confuse polarity interpretation.
- Added validator/tests for Part 2 prompt consistency and placeholder rejection.

## 4. Preservation

- Vocabulary remains 928 records / 928 stable IDs / 26 A–Z files.
- Listening and Reading remain 102/109 questions; no question IDs or question order changed. One reviewed Part 2 response choice was clarified without changing its correct answer index.
- Grammar remains 25 lessons / 54 exercises. No IndexedDB schema, personal vocabulary or study-progress migration was introduced.

- Unit test suites: **116/116 PASS** (the 33-case vocabulary validator regression suite completed across four groups).

## 5. Limitations

- Part 1 assets remain SVG illustrations, not ETS-style photographs. Audio remains browser SpeechSynthesis, not recorded/ETS audio.
- The editorial checks are internal and not independent two-person proofing, psychometric validation or ETS approval.
- Responsive CSS regression checks are automated/static. Browser preview was blocked by the sandbox; physical iPhone/iPad, Android, remote CI and GitHub Pages deployment are unverified.
- Full Mock remains gated on the remaining distractor audit, device QA and release signoff.

# TOEIC Distractor Quality Batch 004 — v2.15.0

**Date:** 10/11/2026  
**Scope:** TOEIC Listening Part 3–4 and Reading Part 7; distractor plausibility and answer uniqueness.  
**Baseline:** v2.14.0.  
**Status:** Applied locally; 126/126 unit-test methods and local validators/audits pass; final ZIP verification is documented in the release report; not deployed.

## Work completed

- Manually reviewed 132 questions with their full transcript/passage, keyed response and three distractors: Listening Part 3 (39), Part 4 (30), Reading Part 7 (63). This scope contains the 126 direct/lexical source-evidence items and six paraphrase/inference questions identified by the prior evidence map.
- Reviewed the key's source support, whether only one option is defensible, grammar/semantic fit, distractor relevance and possible second-correct-answer risk.
- Rewrote 12 question option groups to use distractors closer to the same context: hotel booking, presentation preparation, intended employee groups, travel reimbursement records, refund/return requests, invoice verification, supplier/order enquiries, meeting materials and visitor-access arrangements.
- Kept each updated question's original `answerIndex`, correct answer text, question ID, item order and question count. Added `legacyChoices` snapshots for the 12 revised questions and a backwards-compatible `choiceText` field on new Reading/Listening attempts, so older `choiceIndex` history continues to display the exact original distractor text. No IndexedDB object-store/schema migration or progress reset was performed.
- Added `tools/audit-distractors.py`, generated `docs/reports/TOEIC_DISTRACTOR_AUDIT_v2.15.0.md`, and added five distractor plus five saved-choice-history regression tests.

## Important answer-position finding

Current answer-index distribution is uneven:

| Part | A | B | C | D |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Listening Part 3 | 10 | 18 | 10 | 1 |
| Listening Part 4 | 9 | 12 | 7 | 2 |
| Reading Part 7 | 13 | 27 | 19 | 4 |

The answer positions were **not shuffled** in this batch. The runtime stores historical selections as `choiceIndex` in `readingProgress` and `listeningProgress`; changing choice order without stable choice IDs and migration would corrupt how historical selections are displayed. Future rebalancing must first migrate to stable option identity/choice text and convert legacy saved indices safely.

## Scope protection

- Listening remains 102 questions; Reading remains 109 questions; all IDs, question order and answer keys remain stable.
- The 928 vocabulary records, 26 A–Z files, grammar lessons, design system and PWA app shell remain unchanged except version metadata and audit/test tooling.
- The review is internal editorial work on original-authored questions. It is not a second independent editor's signoff, psychometric analysis, difficulty calibration, official ETS content or proof of score equivalence.

## Next actions

1. Design a stable `choiceId`/choice-text progress format and a non-destructive migration for legacy `choiceIndex` records.
2. Only after migration tests pass, rebalance answer positions by Part with no obvious pattern and verify saved progress/history.
3. Complete second-editor review, physical responsive/audio QA and then implement the timed Full Mock engine.

# Batch 016 — Flashcard image relevance & responsive layout (v2.26.0)

## User requirement
Remove misleading images from vocabulary flashcards, or show only an image that clearly represents that exact vocabulary item. Preserve useful topic-level illustrations separately. Make approved images fit phone/tablet/desktop frames without awkward cropping or overflow.

## Implemented
- Individual vocabulary cards are now text-first by default. They no longer take the first `topics[]` value and display its generic `assets/topics/*` artwork as if it represented the headword.
- Topic thumbnails remain on the topic-selection screen because they represent a category, not an individual vocabulary item.
- A future word-specific illustration is accepted only if all fields are present: `image` path under `./assets/vocabulary/`, meaningful `imageAlt`, and `imageStatus: "approved"`. Paths containing `..` and non-image extensions are rejected.
- Approved image cards use responsive 4:3 frames and `object-fit: contain`; very narrow phones use a compact square frame. Text-only cards use the full card width and do not reserve an empty image column.
- The CSS uses available viewport width, not nominal device-inch measurements. The same design therefore adapts to actual viewport sizes and orientation across 4.7–6.9-inch phones, tablets and desktop screens.

## Data and safety boundaries
- No new image files were downloaded or added. No image has been marked approved.
- All 928 canonical vocabulary records and stable IDs remain unchanged.
- No Listening, Reading, Grammar, Mock Test, TTS or IndexedDB schema/profile data changed.
- Personal IndexedDB import/export/inspection/reset/migration remains deferred.

## Acceptance
- `node tools/tests/flashcard-image-policy.mjs` verifies no generic topic image is rendered on a vocabulary card and enforces the explicit approved-image contract.
- JavaScript syntax, runtime smoke, Mock UI integrity, data validator and version synchronization are checked in the v2.26.0 test report.

## Archived source: `docs/batches/TOEIC_LEXICAL_CLEANUP_BATCH_011_v2.21.0.md`

# TOEIC Vocabulary Batch 011 — Legacy Collocation Cleanup (v2.21.0)

- Date: 11/11/2026
- Base data version: v2.20.0
- Target version: v2.21.0
- Scope: 7 stable vocabulary IDs; 7 guarded `collocations` replacements; 8 legacy FD001 violations removed.
- Data integrity: 928/928 IDs preserved; ID-set SHA-256 remains `dd1705e64c8df4ad7ebca188a6ad856fff1d180d99730d2d77d2ba6fbdc12656`.
- No senses, definitions, examples, IPA, word-family fields, topics, Listening/Reading/Grammar content or question identities changed.

## Reviewed changes

| Stable ID | Previous collocations | Revised collocations | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apprentice-n` | apprentice electrician; apprenticeship program | apprentice electrician; apprentice mechanic | Keep both examples as noun compounds with the headword, avoiding a derived noun that the direct-headword rule cannot trace. Collins documents “apprentice electrician” as a role. |
| `event-coordinator-n` | event coordinator; coordinate an event | event coordinator; assistant event coordinator | Keep role-name phrases for the noun; the old verb phrase was semantically related but not a direct collocation of the noun headword. |
| `fare-n` | airfare; bus fare | bus fare; one-way fare | Use two transparent fare phrases. Cambridge Business English documents “one-way fare”; airfare is valid English but the closed compound was a false negative for the boundary-based rule. |
| `replace-v` | replace a device; replacement part | replace a device; replace a battery | Keep verb + object patterns; Collins explicitly lists “replace a battery” among replace collocations. |
| `reserve-v` | reserve a room; make a reservation | reserve a room; reserve a seat | Keep verb + object patterns; Collins and Cambridge list “reserve a seat”. |
| `warehouseman-n` | warehouse staff; warehouse supervisor | assistant warehouseman; bonded warehouseman | Replace broad warehouse-role associations with compound job-title forms that contain the headword. A historical occupational dictionary defines assistant warehouseman and warehouseman, bonded. |
| `zero-based-budgeting-n` | zero-based budgeting process; zero-based budget | zero-based budgeting process; zero-based budgeting method | Keep phrases built from the exact headword; the second phrase no longer shifts to the related noun “budget”. |

## Guarded patch and baseline handling

- Patch file: `patches/v2.21.0/batch-011-collocations.json`.
- Guard: base data version, complete 928-ID set SHA-256, stable record IDs and exact old `collocations` values.
- Dry-run: PASS before apply.
- Apply: PASS, 7 operations across 6 A–Z JSON files.
- `python tools/validate-data.py` after apply: 0 ERROR; all 8 FD001 records reported as resolved.
- `python tools/validate-data.py --tighten-baseline`: removed exactly 8 resolved FD001 entries, added none.
- Final validator: 0 ERROR / 0 WARNING (legacy).

## Source notes

1. Collins Dictionary, “apprentice electrician”: https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/apprentice-electrician
2. Collins Dictionary, “event coordinator”: https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/event-coordinator
3. Cambridge Dictionary, “one-way” (Business English entry gives “one-way fare”): https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/one-way
4. Collins Collocations, “replace”: https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english-collocations/replace
5. Collins Collocations, “reserve”: https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english-collocations/reserve
6. Dictionary of Occupational Terms, “940.—Warehousemen” (assistant warehouseman; warehouseman, bonded): https://doot.spub.co.uk/code.php?value=940
7. Howard County Public School System, Zero-Based Budgeting Overview: https://www.hcpss.org/f/aboutus/zbb_manual.pdf

These sources support phrase formation and role/term usage; they do not constitute a complete TOEIC frequency ranking. No official ETS vocabulary list is implied.

# Batch 015 — Full TOEIC Mock Practice Beta (v2.25.0)

## Objective
Deliver the three user-requested timed Listening & Reading test modes using the existing reviewed question pool. Keep the build independent from IndexedDB personal data.

## Formats

| Mode | Listening | Reading | Total | Questions |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Quick | 05:22 | 09:38 | 15 min | 12 + 13 = 25 |
| Half | 22:30 | 37:30 | 60 min | 50 + 50 = 100 |
| Full | 45:00 | 75:00 | 120 min | 100 + 100 = 200 |

## Content selection

- Eligible existing content: Listening 102 questions; Reading 109 questions.
- Listening reserve Batch 013: 11 questions are excluded because their `editorialStatus` is `reserve-pending-independent-review`.
- Full form: Listening Part 1–4 = 6/25/39/30; Reading Part 5–7 = 30/16/54, with Part 7 selection of 29 single-passage + 25 multiple-passage questions.
- Randomization is at the question or source-block level as appropriate. Part 3/4 three-question audio units, Part 6 four-question passage sets and each Part 7 source block remain indivisible. The generator rejects a form with duplicate stable question IDs or a pool that cannot satisfy the exact target.
- A separate lifetime-use ledger stored in `toeic:mock-usage:v1` contributes question-use counts independently of the most-recent-60 display history; least-used eligible questions are prioritized, including after older attempts age out of the visible history. The current bank only fits one full 200-question blueprint in several Parts, so repeated full tests cannot yet be guaranteed to be entirely disjoint. The UI reports reused question count rather than concealing it.

## User interface

- New desktop sidebar and mobile Học tập entry, dashboard shortcut and dedicated `page-mock`.
- Three mode cards and data-pool counts.
- Section timer and auto transition Listening → Reading; Reading cannot return to Listening.
- Question map, answer selection, flag/unflag, submitted/unanswered count and local resume.
- Part 1 displays the JPG photograph path and switches to the existing SVG fallback after a JPG load error. Part 3/4 use the existing Listening TTS, not licensed/ETS recordings.
- Reading displays source passage/documents. Transcript and source text are revealed in review after submission.
- Results show total raw correct count, separate visual Listening/Reading score rings with raw counts and accuracy, unanswered counts, the additional correct answers needed to reach the internal 75% target, per-Part accuracy, learning guidance, answer explanations and history. No ETS-equated 5–495/10–990 estimate is fabricated.

## Score integrity

No ETS 10–990 score or CEFR conversion is fabricated. ETS scaled scoring is based on equated score conversion; this content collection does not contain form-specific equating tables. The result is explicitly labeled as practice-only.

## Storage and non-regression

Dedicated keys: `toeic:mock-history:v1`, `toeic:mock-active:v1`, `toeic:mock-last-result:v1`. The mock feature does not call the existing IndexedDB wrapper, change DB version 1, create stores, or modify vocabulary/Reading/Listening/Grammar study progress. No personal profile inspection/import/export/reset/migration was performed.

## Automated checks

- `node tools/tests/mock-exam-engine.mjs`: PASS.
- `node tools/tests/runtime-render-smoke.mjs`: PASS.
- `node tools/tests/listening-tts-regression.mjs`: PASS.
- JS syntax/static HTML checks: PASS.

## Remaining release gates

- Actual 8 JPG binaries are missing from the local source snapshot. The Part 1 UI fallback exists, but strict photo validation still must pass 8/8 on the actual repository before release.
- Local Chromium / physical laptop/tablet/iPhone/Android QA has not been verified in this work cycle.
- Remote GitHub Actions and GitHub Pages deployment have not been run from the user's repository.
- Independent TOEIC content/editorial review is pending; Batch 013 reserve stays excluded.
- More reserve content is needed for multiple non-overlapping 200-question forms.

## Archived source: `docs/batches/TOEIC_TTS_PLAYBACK_HARDENING_BATCH_014_v2.24.0.md`

# TOEIC Listening/TTS playback hardening — Batch 014 (v2.24.0)

**Date:** 11/11/2026  
**Scope:** Make Listening/TTS playback cancellation deterministic across browser speech engines. This is a reliability fix, not a new recorded-audio/voice-quality claim.

## Findings

- Existing TTS already supported separate male/female voice selection, a Daniel en-GB male fallback when exposed by the device, per-speaker voice reuse, per-lesson speed, a configurable pause between words and a configurable pause between dialogue turns.
- Playback cancellation previously depended on the browser firing an utterance `onerror` callback after `speechSynthesis.cancel()`. Browser implementations may not always deliver the callback consistently; a sequential playback promise could remain pending and block the next session's UI flow.
- A normal user stop/interruption could also be surfaced as a generic voice error in the one-off pronunciation preview.

## Changes

1. Added an app-owned `activeSpeechCancel` resolver for the current speech utterance.
2. `stopSpeech()` now resolves that app-owned callback before asking the browser to cancel the audio queue. This guarantees that the current playback sequence unwinds even if the browser emits no cancel event.
3. `speakUtterance()` clears the active resolver on completion, failure or cancellation, while preserving the playback-token guard that prevents stale sessions from advancing.
4. One-off pronunciation previews suppress expected `canceled` and `interrupted` events; real synthesis errors still show a useful error message.
5. Added `tools/tests/listening-tts-regression.mjs` and registered it in GitHub Actions.

## Preservation

- No changes to Listening content, question/choice IDs, answer keys, transcripts, vocabulary or Reading/Grammar datasets.
- No changes to `DEFAULT_TTS_SETTINGS`, voice recommendation rules, default pauses or the speaker/voice model.
- No audio provider, paid voice API, remote endpoint or audio asset was introduced.
- IndexedDB remains database `toeic-vocabulary-phase1`, version 1, store `workspace`; no schema/profile migration or reset. Personal profile import/export/inspection remains deferred.

## Local regression coverage

The deterministic mocked-speech test checks:

- A manually selected male voice takes precedence over automatic selection.
- Daniel en-GB remains the automatic male fallback when present and no manual voice is saved.
- Multi-speaker playback keeps a stable selected voice for each named speaker.
- The configured playback rate and turn pause are applied.
- Vocabulary is spoken as separate words with the exact configured gap.
- `stopSpeech()` resolves the active sequence even when the mock browser emits no cancellation event; queued subsequent turns are not started.
- Expected cancellation of a one-off voice preview does not show a false synthesis error.

## QA boundary / next actions

- Automated tests validate JavaScript orchestration only. They cannot assess accent authenticity, male-voice timbre, loudness, noise, pronunciation quality or actual pause perception.
- Listen and compare available male/female voice packs on Windows desktop, iPhone Safari and Android Chrome. Prefer a device-provided natural voice only after listening; do not infer acoustic quality from a voice name or `localService` flag.
- If recorded or commercial TTS audio is considered later, evaluate licensing, redistribution rights, file size, offline behavior and the GitHub-only/no-backend constraint before adding assets.
- Part 1 strict image QA remains blocked by missing JPG bytes in this local snapshot (0/8); remote GitHub Actions/Pages and physical-device QA are not claimed.

## Archived source: `docs/batches/VOCABULARY_BATCH_006.md`

# Vocabulary Batch 006 — v2.9.9 Batch 001

**Trạng thái:** Đã áp dụng trong working tree v2.9.9; chưa phải ZIP phát hành cuối cùng.  
**Nền dữ liệu:** v2.9.8, 928 headwords.  
**Phạm vi:** 40 headwords A–C; sửa `definition_en` và ví dụ tiếng Anh/bản dịch.  
**Cơ chế:** `patches/v2.9.9/batch-001.json`, kiểm tra ID + SHA-256 + `expect.old` + POS; có `--dry-run`, `--apply`, `--rollback`.

## Tiêu chí biên tập

- Definition là câu/nhóm từ định nghĩa tiếng Anh tự nhiên, không lặp lại headword ở đầu theo dạng nhãn.
- Ví dụ đặt trong ngữ cảnh TOEIC (văn phòng, tài chính, cuộc họp, vận hành, kho vận, dịch vụ); không dùng câu khuôn chung.
- Bản dịch diễn đạt tự nhiên, giữ đúng nghĩa của câu tiếng Anh.
- Không thay đổi ID, POS, IPA, CEFR, word family, verb forms, collocations, synonyms hoặc antonyms.
- Đây là nội dung biên tập mới, không sao chép nguyên văn ví dụ của từ điển tham khảo.

## Danh sách 40 mục đã xử lý

| ID | Headword | Definition tiếng Anh mới | Ví dụ tiếng Anh mới | Bản dịch |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| absence-n | absence | the fact of not being present in a place or at an event | The employee's absence was recorded in the attendance system. | Sự vắng mặt của nhân viên đã được ghi nhận trong hệ thống chấm công. |
| accommodate-v | accommodate | to provide enough space for someone or something, or to adjust to someone's needs | The conference room can accommodate up to forty participants. | Phòng hội nghị có thể đáp ứng chỗ ngồi cho tối đa bốn mươi người tham dự. |
| accomplish-v | accomplish | to succeed in doing or completing something, especially a task or goal | The project team accomplished all of its targets ahead of schedule. | Nhóm dự án đã hoàn thành tất cả mục tiêu trước thời hạn. |
| accordance-n | accordance | the condition of following a rule, instruction, or standard; commonly used in “in accordance with” | All expense claims must be submitted in accordance with company policy. | Mọi đề nghị thanh toán chi phí phải được gửi theo đúng chính sách công ty. |
| accountable-adj | accountable | responsible for actions or decisions and required to explain them | Each department manager is accountable for the accuracy of the monthly report. | Mỗi trưởng phòng chịu trách nhiệm về độ chính xác của báo cáo hằng tháng. |
| accrue-v | accrue | to increase or accumulate gradually over time, especially money, interest, or benefits | Interest will accrue on the outstanding balance until it is paid in full. | Tiền lãi sẽ tích lũy trên số dư còn nợ cho đến khi được thanh toán đầy đủ. |
| accurate-adj | accurate | correct and exact, with no significant mistakes | Please make sure that the figures in the sales report are accurate. | Vui lòng đảm bảo các số liệu trong báo cáo bán hàng là chính xác. |
| activate-v | activate | to make a system, device, account, or process start working | New employees must activate their accounts before accessing the portal. | Nhân viên mới phải kích hoạt tài khoản trước khi truy cập cổng thông tin. |
| additional-adj | additional | extra; added to what is already available or required | The supplier agreed to deliver the additional office chairs by Friday. | Nhà cung cấp đồng ý giao thêm số ghế văn phòng trước thứ Sáu. |
| adjacent-adj | adjacent | next to or sharing a boundary with something | The training room is adjacent to the main conference hall. | Phòng đào tạo nằm liền kề hội trường chính. |
| adjustment-n | adjustment | a small change made to improve something or make it suitable | The finance department made an adjustment to the travel budget. | Phòng tài chính đã điều chỉnh ngân sách công tác. |
| administrative-adj | administrative | related to organizing, managing, or running the work of an organization | Administrative staff will send the revised schedule to all employees. | Nhân viên hành chính sẽ gửi lịch trình đã sửa đổi cho toàn thể nhân viên. |
| administrator-n | administrator | a person responsible for managing an organization, system, or process | Contact the system administrator if your account is locked. | Hãy liên hệ quản trị viên hệ thống nếu tài khoản của bạn bị khóa. |
| admission-n | admission | permission to enter a place or event; the fee charged for entry | Admission to the annual trade exhibition is free for registered customers. | Khách hàng đã đăng ký được vào triển lãm thương mại thường niên miễn phí. |
| adopt-v | adopt | to formally accept or begin using a plan, policy, or method | The board voted to adopt the new customer service guidelines. | Hội đồng đã bỏ phiếu thông qua bộ hướng dẫn dịch vụ khách hàng mới. |
| allocation-n | allocation | the process of assigning money, time, or resources for a particular purpose | The allocation of funds for staff training was approved last week. | Việc phân bổ kinh phí đào tạo nhân viên đã được phê duyệt tuần trước. |
| amend-v | amend | to make a formal change to a document, contract, or law | Both parties agreed to amend the contract before signing it. | Hai bên đồng ý sửa đổi hợp đồng trước khi ký. |
| annually-adv | annually | once every year | The company reviews employee performance annually. | Công ty đánh giá hiệu quả làm việc của nhân viên hằng năm. |
| apologize-v | apologize | to tell someone that you are sorry for a mistake or for causing trouble | The airline apologized to passengers for the unexpected delay. | Hãng hàng không đã xin lỗi hành khách vì sự chậm trễ ngoài dự kiến. |
| applicable-adj | applicable | relevant to a particular person, situation, or set of conditions | The discount is applicable to orders placed before the end of the month. | Mức giảm giá được áp dụng cho các đơn hàng đặt trước cuối tháng. |
| approval-n | approval | official agreement or permission for a plan, request, or action | The marketing proposal is awaiting approval from the regional director. | Đề xuất tiếp thị đang chờ giám đốc khu vực phê duyệt. |
| approximately-adv | approximately | used to indicate an amount, time, or number that is close to but not exactly correct | The replacement parts are expected to arrive in approximately five days. | Các linh kiện thay thế dự kiến sẽ đến trong khoảng năm ngày. |
| arrangement-n | arrangement | a plan or agreement made in advance about how something will happen | The travel arrangements for the visiting delegates have been finalized. | Các sắp xếp đi lại cho đoàn đại biểu đến thăm đã được hoàn tất. |
| assess-v | assess | to examine something and judge its quality, value, importance, or condition | The consultant will assess the building before preparing a renovation estimate. | Chuyên gia tư vấn sẽ đánh giá tòa nhà trước khi lập dự toán cải tạo. |
| assistance-n | assistance | help or support given to someone who needs it | Customers can request technical assistance through the support center. | Khách hàng có thể yêu cầu hỗ trợ kỹ thuật thông qua trung tâm hỗ trợ. |
| attendance-n | attendance | the act of being present at a meeting, event, or place | Attendance at the safety training session is required for all warehouse staff. | Toàn bộ nhân viên kho bắt buộc tham dự buổi đào tạo an toàn. |
| attendee-n | attendee | a person who is present at a meeting, conference, or other event | Each attendee will receive a copy of the conference program at registration. | Mỗi người tham dự sẽ nhận một bản chương trình hội nghị khi đăng ký. |
| authorization-n | authorization | official permission to do something or to access something | Written authorization is required before confidential files can be released. | Cần có văn bản ủy quyền trước khi hồ sơ mật được cung cấp. |
| authorize-v | authorize | to give someone official permission to do something | Only the finance director can authorize payments above the stated limit. | Chỉ giám đốc tài chính mới có quyền phê duyệt các khoản thanh toán vượt hạn mức đã quy định. |
| backlog-n | backlog | a quantity of work, orders, or requests that have not yet been completed | The support team is hiring temporary staff to reduce its backlog of requests. | Nhóm hỗ trợ đang tuyển nhân viên thời vụ để giảm lượng yêu cầu tồn đọng. |
| backup-n | backup | a copy of data kept in case the original is lost, or a person or resource ready to provide support | The IT team creates a backup of the customer database every night. | Đội CNTT tạo bản sao lưu cơ sở dữ liệu khách hàng mỗi đêm. |
| bargain-n | bargain | an agreement reached after discussion, or something bought at a price lower than usual | The purchasing manager negotiated a bargain with the equipment supplier. | Trưởng bộ phận mua hàng đã thương lượng được một thỏa thuận có lợi với nhà cung cấp thiết bị. |
| beneficial-adj | beneficial | helpful or producing a positive effect | Flexible working hours can be beneficial to employees with long commutes. | Giờ làm việc linh hoạt có thể mang lại lợi ích cho nhân viên phải đi làm xa. |
| billable-adj | billable | able to be charged to a customer or included on an invoice | The consultant records all billable hours in the project management system. | Chuyên gia tư vấn ghi lại toàn bộ số giờ có thể tính phí trong hệ thống quản lý dự án. |
| billing-n | billing | the process of preparing invoices and collecting payment for goods or services | The billing department will issue the revised invoice tomorrow. | Bộ phận lập hóa đơn sẽ phát hành hóa đơn đã điều chỉnh vào ngày mai. |
| briefing-n | briefing | a short meeting or summary that provides essential information or instructions | All drivers must attend a safety briefing before starting their shifts. | Tất cả tài xế phải tham dự buổi phổ biến an toàn trước khi bắt đầu ca làm. |
| capacity-n | capacity | the maximum amount something can hold or the ability to perform a task | The new warehouse has the capacity to store 8,000 packages. | Nhà kho mới có sức chứa 8.000 kiện hàng. |
| cargo-n | cargo | goods carried by a ship, aircraft, train, or truck | The cargo was inspected before it was loaded onto the aircraft. | Hàng hóa đã được kiểm tra trước khi được xếp lên máy bay. |
| certificate-n | certificate | an official document that confirms a fact, qualification, or completed course | Applicants must submit a safety training certificate with their forms. | Ứng viên phải nộp chứng chỉ đào tạo an toàn kèm theo hồ sơ. |
| circulate-v | circulate | to distribute a document or information to a group, or to move continuously through a system | Please circulate the updated meeting agenda to all department heads. | Vui lòng gửi chương trình họp đã cập nhật đến tất cả trưởng bộ phận. |

# Vocabulary Quality Correction Batch 002 — v2.9.9

**Trạng thái:** Đã dry-run và áp dụng bằng `tools/patch-data.py`; đã chạy validator. Đây là working tree, chưa phải ZIP phát hành cuối.
**Nền dữ liệu:** v2.9.8, 928 ID; `baseDataVersion=2.9.8`; `idSetSha256` giữ nguyên.
**Phạm vi:** 40 headwords; sửa definition tiếng Anh và rà soát ví dụ/bản dịch theo ngữ cảnh TOEIC.
**Patch:** `patches/v2.9.9/batch-002.json` (119 thao tác).

Mỗi thao tác khóa theo ID, JSON Pointer và `expect.old`; trường definition còn kiểm tra POS. Patch hủy toàn batch nếu dữ liệu nền không khớp. Không thay đổi ID/POS/IPA/CEFR/schema hoặc dữ liệu cá nhân.

## Danh sách mục đã xử lý

| ID | Headword | Definition tiếng Anh mới | Ví dụ tiếng Anh | Bản dịch tiếng Việt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| clarify-v | clarify | to make information, instructions, or a situation easier to understand | The purchasing manager asked the supplier to clarify the delivery terms. | Trưởng bộ phận mua hàng yêu cầu nhà cung cấp làm rõ các điều khoản giao hàng. |
| clientele-n | clientele | the people who regularly buy goods or use services from a business | The new branch is designed to serve a younger clientele. | Chi nhánh mới được thiết kế để phục vụ nhóm khách hàng trẻ hơn. |
| compensation-n | compensation | money or benefits given in return for work, or to make up for loss or injury | The compensation package includes a transport allowance and health insurance. | Gói đãi ngộ bao gồm phụ cấp đi lại và bảo hiểm y tế. |
| competitive-adj | competitive | able to compete successfully, especially because of price, quality, or performance | The company offers competitive salaries to attract experienced engineers. | Công ty đưa ra mức lương cạnh tranh để thu hút các kỹ sư giàu kinh nghiệm. |
| competitor-n | competitor | a person or organization that offers similar products or services and competes for the same customers | A major competitor has opened a new store across the street. | Một đối thủ cạnh tranh lớn đã mở cửa hàng mới bên kia đường. |
| completion-n | completion | the act or result of finishing a task, project, or process | Final payment will be made upon completion of the installation. | Khoản thanh toán cuối cùng sẽ được thực hiện sau khi hoàn tất việc lắp đặt. |
| comply-v | comply | to act according to a rule, law, request, or official requirement | All contractors must comply with the company’s safety regulations. | Tất cả nhà thầu phải tuân thủ các quy định an toàn của công ty. |
| confidential-adj | confidential | intended to be kept private and not shared with people who are not authorized | Employees must not disclose confidential customer information. | Nhân viên không được tiết lộ thông tin khách hàng bảo mật. |
| confirmation-n | confirmation | a statement or message showing that an arrangement, booking, or fact is definite | You will receive an email confirmation after your reservation is processed. | Bạn sẽ nhận được email xác nhận sau khi đặt chỗ được xử lý. |
| consecutive-adj | consecutive | following one after another without a break or interruption | The warehouse recorded three consecutive days without a shipping delay. | Nhà kho ghi nhận ba ngày liên tiếp không xảy ra chậm trễ giao hàng. |
| consent-n | consent | permission or agreement given for something to happen | The survey will be conducted only after participants give their consent. | Khảo sát chỉ được tiến hành sau khi người tham gia đưa ra sự đồng ý. |
| consumable-n | consumable | a product or material that is used up during normal operations and must be replaced | The office orders printer ink and other consumables every month. | Văn phòng đặt mực in và các vật tư tiêu hao khác mỗi tháng. |
| consumption-n | consumption | the amount of a resource, product, or service that is used | The new lighting system has reduced electricity consumption. | Hệ thống chiếu sáng mới đã giảm mức tiêu thụ điện. |
| contractual-adj | contractual | relating to a contract or to duties and rights established by a contract | The supplier failed to meet its contractual obligations. | Nhà cung cấp đã không thực hiện đúng các nghĩa vụ theo hợp đồng. |
| coordinate-v | coordinate | to organize people, activities, or resources so that they work together effectively | The event coordinator will coordinate transportation for all speakers. | Điều phối viên sự kiện sẽ phối hợp việc đưa đón tất cả diễn giả. |
| courtesy-n | courtesy | polite behavior or a considerate action intended to show respect | As a courtesy, the hotel will provide a shuttle to the airport. | Để thể hiện sự chu đáo, khách sạn sẽ cung cấp xe đưa đón đến sân bay. |
| coverage-n | coverage | the protection or services included in an insurance or warranty plan; the area or amount included | The extended warranty provides coverage for parts and labor. | Gói bảo hành mở rộng bao gồm chi phí linh kiện và nhân công. |
| creditor-n | creditor | a person or organization to whom money is owed | The company negotiated a longer repayment period with its creditors. | Công ty đã đàm phán thời hạn trả nợ dài hơn với các chủ nợ. |
| deduct-v | deduct | to take an amount away from a total, salary, or payment | The employer will deduct income tax from each monthly salary. | Người sử dụng lao động sẽ khấu trừ thuế thu nhập từ mỗi tháng lương. |
| deduction-n | deduction | an amount that is subtracted from a total, especially for tax or another payment | The payslip shows a deduction for the employee’s health insurance. | Phiếu lương thể hiện khoản khấu trừ cho bảo hiểm y tế của nhân viên. |
| defective-adj | defective | not working correctly or not made properly because of a fault | Customers may return defective products within thirty days. | Khách hàng có thể trả lại sản phẩm bị lỗi trong vòng ba mươi ngày. |
| deficit-n | deficit | an amount by which expenses or demand are greater than income, supply, or available resources | The department must reduce its budget deficit before the next quarter. | Bộ phận phải giảm mức thâm hụt ngân sách trước quý tới. |
| delegate-v | delegate | to give a task or responsibility to another person, usually with the authority to complete it | The director decided to delegate routine approvals to the regional managers. | Giám đốc quyết định ủy quyền phê duyệt công việc thường lệ cho các quản lý khu vực. |
| deliverable-n | deliverable | a product, document, or result that must be provided as part of a project or agreement | The final report is the last deliverable under the consulting contract. | Báo cáo cuối cùng là sản phẩm bàn giao cuối cùng theo hợp đồng tư vấn. |
| departure-n | departure | the act or scheduled time of leaving a place | Passengers should arrive at the gate thirty minutes before departure. | Hành khách nên có mặt tại cửa khởi hành trước ba mươi phút. |
| disclose-v | disclose | to make information known, especially information that was previously private or secret | The applicant must disclose any conflicts of interest on the form. | Ứng viên phải công khai mọi xung đột lợi ích trên biểu mẫu. |
| discrepancy-n | discrepancy | a difference between two pieces of information or amounts that should match | The accountant found a discrepancy between the invoice and the purchase order. | Kế toán phát hiện sự sai lệch giữa hóa đơn và đơn đặt hàng. |
| distribute-v | distribute | to deliver or share goods, documents, or information among several people or places | Reception will distribute the updated visitor badges this afternoon. | Bộ phận lễ tân sẽ phát thẻ khách đã cập nhật vào chiều nay. |
| documentation-n | documentation | documents that provide information, evidence, or instructions about something | Please keep the shipping documentation for customs inspection. | Vui lòng lưu giữ hồ sơ chứng từ vận chuyển để phục vụ kiểm tra hải quan. |
| duplicate-adj | duplicate | exactly the same as another item, or repeated when only one copy is needed | The database detected duplicate customer records and flagged them for review. | Cơ sở dữ liệu phát hiện các hồ sơ khách hàng trùng lặp và đánh dấu để rà soát. |
| durable-adj | durable | able to last a long time without becoming damaged or worn out | The manufacturer uses durable materials for its outdoor equipment. | Nhà sản xuất sử dụng vật liệu bền cho thiết bị ngoài trời. |
| duration-n | duration | the length of time that an event, activity, or condition continues | The training course has a duration of two weeks. | Khóa đào tạo có thời lượng hai tuần. |
| efficiently-adv | efficiently | in a way that uses time, energy, or resources without unnecessary waste | The new software allows staff to process invoices more efficiently. | Phần mềm mới giúp nhân viên xử lý hóa đơn hiệu quả hơn. |
| electronic-adj | electronic | using a computer, digital system, or electronic equipment rather than paper or mechanical methods | Electronic receipts are sent automatically after each online purchase. | Biên lai điện tử được gửi tự động sau mỗi lần mua hàng trực tuyến. |
| eligibility-n | eligibility | the state of meeting the conditions required to receive or do something | Eligibility for the housing allowance depends on length of service. | Điều kiện được hưởng trợ cấp nhà ở phụ thuộc vào thâm niên công tác. |
| eligible-adj | eligible | meeting the conditions required to receive or do something | Employees who have completed six months of service are eligible for the benefit. | Nhân viên đã làm việc đủ sáu tháng sẽ đủ điều kiện nhận phúc lợi. |
| emission-n | emission | the release of gas, heat, light, or another substance into the environment | The factory must report its annual carbon emissions to the authorities. | Nhà máy phải báo cáo lượng khí thải carbon hằng năm cho cơ quan chức năng. |
| enclose-v | enclose | to put something inside an envelope or package with another item, or to surround something | Please enclose a copy of your receipt with the warranty claim. | Vui lòng gửi kèm một bản sao biên lai cùng yêu cầu bảo hành. |
| endorse-v | endorse | to publicly express support for something, or to sign a document to make it valid | The board voted to endorse the revised investment proposal. | Hội đồng đã bỏ phiếu tán thành đề xuất đầu tư đã sửa đổi. |
| enquiry-n | enquiry | a question or request for information about a product, service, or situation | Our sales team received an enquiry about bulk delivery rates. | Đội ngũ bán hàng nhận được yêu cầu thông tin về mức phí giao hàng số lượng lớn. |

## Kiểm soát chất lượng

- Kiểm tra nội dung theo nghĩa, từ loại và bối cảnh TOEIC; ví dụ phải tự nhiên, có bản dịch tương ứng.
- Không tự sinh IPA, CEFR hoặc quan hệ từ; giữ nguyên các trường này.
- Validator sau khi áp dụng phải có 0 ERROR. Chỉ siết baseline sau khi các nội dung đã được rà soát; không thêm lỗi mới.

**Trạng thái:** Đã dry-run và áp dụng bằng `tools/patch-data.py`; đã chạy validator. Đây là working tree, chưa phải ZIP phát hành cuối.

**Phạm vi:** 40 headwords; sửa definition tiếng Anh và rà soát ví dụ/bản dịch theo ngữ cảnh TOEIC.
**Patch:** `patches/v2.9.9/batch-003.json` (120 thao tác).

Mỗi thao tác khóa theo ID, JSON Pointer và `expect.old`; trường definition còn kiểm tra POS. Patch hủy toàn batch nếu dữ liệu nền không khớp. Không thay đổi ID/POS/IPA/CEFR/schema hoặc dữ liệu cá nhân.

## Danh sách mục đã xử lý

| ID | Headword | Definition tiếng Anh mới | Ví dụ tiếng Anh | Bản dịch tiếng Việt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| equivalent-adj | equivalent | equal in value, function, meaning, or importance to something else | The replacement battery is equivalent to the original model. | Pin thay thế có thông số tương đương với mẫu ban đầu. |
| exempt-adj | exempt | not required to do something or pay a particular charge because of a rule or special condition | Small businesses may be exempt from the annual registration fee. | Các doanh nghiệp nhỏ có thể được miễn lệ phí đăng ký hằng năm. |
| expiration-n | expiration | the end of the period during which a document, agreement, or product remains valid or usable | Please check the expiration date before renewing your access card. | Vui lòng kiểm tra ngày hết hạn trước khi gia hạn thẻ truy cập. |
| extension-n | extension | an arrangement that gives extra time, or an additional part connected to something; also a telephone line number | The client requested an extension of the payment deadline. | Khách hàng đề nghị gia hạn thời hạn thanh toán. |
| facilitate-v | facilitate | to make an action or process easier to do | The online form is designed to facilitate the registration process. | Biểu mẫu trực tuyến được thiết kế để tạo thuận lợi cho quy trình đăng ký. |
| feasibility-n | feasibility | the possibility that a plan or project can be carried out successfully | The engineering team will study the feasibility of building a second warehouse. | Đội ngũ kỹ thuật sẽ nghiên cứu tính khả thi của việc xây dựng nhà kho thứ hai. |
| feasible-adj | feasible | possible and practical to do under the available conditions | The manager believes that the proposed delivery schedule is feasible. | Quản lý tin rằng lịch giao hàng được đề xuất là khả thi. |
| flexibility-n | flexibility | the ability to change or adapt to different needs, conditions, or arrangements | The company introduced flexible shifts to give employees more flexibility. | Công ty áp dụng ca làm linh hoạt để nhân viên có thêm sự linh hoạt. |
| fulfill-v | fulfill | to do what is required, promised, or expected; to satisfy a need or condition | The supplier must fulfill every requirement listed in the purchase agreement. | Nhà cung cấp phải đáp ứng mọi yêu cầu được nêu trong thỏa thuận mua hàng. |
| generate-v | generate | to produce or create something, such as income, information, or electricity | The new advertising campaign is expected to generate more online sales. | Chiến dịch quảng cáo mới được kỳ vọng tạo ra thêm doanh thu trực tuyến. |
| guideline-n | guideline | a general rule or piece of advice that helps people make decisions or perform a task | The handbook provides guidelines for handling customer complaints. | Sổ tay cung cấp hướng dẫn về cách xử lý khiếu nại của khách hàng. |
| handling-n | handling | the way something is dealt with, managed, or physically treated | Careful handling is required when loading fragile equipment. | Cần thao tác cẩn thận khi xếp dỡ thiết bị dễ vỡ. |
| implement-v | implement | to put a plan, decision, or system into practical use | The company will implement the revised attendance policy next month. | Công ty sẽ triển khai chính sách chấm công đã sửa đổi vào tháng tới. |
| incentive-n | incentive | something offered to encourage a person to take an action or achieve a goal | Employees who exceed their sales targets may receive a financial incentive. | Nhân viên vượt chỉ tiêu bán hàng có thể nhận được khoản khuyến khích tài chính. |
| incentivize-v | incentivize | to encourage a particular action by offering a reward or benefit | The new commission plan is intended to incentivize higher sales. | Chính sách hoa hồng mới nhằm khuyến khích tăng doanh số. |
| inquire-v | inquire | to ask for information about something | Please inquire at the reception desk if you need a visitor pass. | Vui lòng hỏi tại quầy lễ tân nếu bạn cần thẻ khách. |
| inquiry-n | inquiry | a request for information, or an official examination of a matter | The customer submitted an inquiry about the status of the refund. | Khách hàng đã gửi yêu cầu thông tin về tình trạng hoàn tiền. |
| inspection-n | inspection | an official or careful examination to check quality, safety, or condition | The building passed its annual fire safety inspection. | Tòa nhà đã vượt qua đợt kiểm tra an toàn phòng cháy hằng năm. |
| inspector-n | inspector | a person whose job is to examine something to make sure that it meets required standards | A safety inspector will visit the factory on Thursday. | Một thanh tra an toàn sẽ đến nhà máy vào thứ Năm. |
| invoicing-n | invoicing | the process of preparing and sending invoices for goods or services | Automated invoicing has reduced paperwork in the accounting department. | Việc lập hóa đơn tự động đã giảm giấy tờ trong phòng kế toán. |
| justify-v | justify | to provide a good reason or evidence to show that an action or decision is reasonable | The project manager must justify the additional expense in the budget report. | Quản lý dự án phải giải trình khoản chi phí bổ sung trong báo cáo ngân sách. |
| laboratory-n | laboratory | a place equipped for scientific tests, research, or technical examination | The product samples were sent to an independent laboratory for testing. | Các mẫu sản phẩm đã được gửi đến phòng thí nghiệm độc lập để kiểm tra. |
| lessee-n | lessee | a person or organization that rents property or equipment under a lease | The lessee must maintain the office space throughout the rental period. | Bên thuê phải bảo trì mặt bằng văn phòng trong suốt thời hạn thuê. |
| lessor-n | lessor | a person or organization that allows another party to use property or equipment in return for rent | The lessor agreed to repair the air-conditioning system before the office opens. | Bên cho thuê đồng ý sửa hệ thống điều hòa trước khi văn phòng khai trương. |
| liability-n | liability | a legal responsibility or a debt that an individual or organization must pay | The company recorded the unpaid tax as a current liability. | Công ty ghi nhận khoản thuế chưa nộp là một khoản nợ ngắn hạn. |
| maintenance-n | maintenance | work done regularly to keep a building, machine, or system in good condition | Routine maintenance will be carried out after business hours. | Công tác bảo trì định kỳ sẽ được thực hiện sau giờ làm việc. |
| mandatory-adj | mandatory | required by a law, rule, or official instruction; not optional | Wearing a safety helmet is mandatory inside the construction area. | Việc đội mũ bảo hộ là bắt buộc trong khu vực xây dựng. |
| manufacturer-n | manufacturer | a company or person that makes goods in large quantities for sale | The manufacturer will replace any unit that fails during the warranty period. | Nhà sản xuất sẽ thay thế mọi thiết bị bị hỏng trong thời hạn bảo hành. |
| nevertheless-adj | nevertheless | despite what has just been said or the situation described; however | The shipment was delayed; nevertheless, the customer agreed to keep the order. | Lô hàng bị chậm trễ; tuy nhiên, khách hàng vẫn đồng ý giữ đơn hàng. |
| occupancy-n | occupancy | the state or number of people using or living in a building, room, or other space | The hotel expects an occupancy rate of more than eighty percent this weekend. | Khách sạn dự kiến tỷ lệ lấp đầy phòng sẽ vượt tám mươi phần trăm vào cuối tuần này. |
| officeholder-n | officeholder | a person who currently holds an official position or public office | The officeholder must submit an annual statement of interests. | Người giữ chức vụ phải nộp bản kê khai lợi ích hằng năm. |
| outsource-v | outsource | to arrange for an outside company or person to perform work instead of doing it internally | The retailer decided to outsource its delivery operations to a logistics provider. | Nhà bán lẻ quyết định thuê một đơn vị logistics bên ngoài thực hiện hoạt động giao hàng. |
| outsourcing-n | outsourcing | the practice of paying an outside organization to perform work or provide services | Outsourcing customer support helped the company reduce operating costs. | Việc thuê ngoài dịch vụ chăm sóc khách hàng đã giúp công ty giảm chi phí vận hành. |
| outstanding-adj | outstanding | not yet paid, completed, or resolved; also exceptionally good | Please settle all outstanding invoices before the end of the quarter. | Vui lòng thanh toán tất cả hóa đơn còn tồn đọng trước khi kết thúc quý. |
| overdue-adj | overdue | not paid, returned, or completed by the expected or required date | The library sent reminders to members with overdue books. | Thư viện gửi thông báo nhắc nhở các thành viên chưa trả sách đúng hạn. |
| overhaul-n | overhaul | a thorough examination and repair or major improvement of a system or organization | The airline scheduled a complete overhaul of its booking platform. | Hãng hàng không lên lịch đại tu toàn bộ nền tảng đặt chỗ. |
| parcel-n | parcel | a package or wrapped item sent or delivered to someone | The courier left the parcel at the reception desk. | Nhân viên chuyển phát đã để bưu kiện tại quầy lễ tân. |
| participant-n | participant | a person who takes part in an activity, event, or program | Each participant must complete the online safety course before the workshop. | Mỗi người tham gia phải hoàn thành khóa an toàn trực tuyến trước buổi hội thảo. |
| payable-adj | payable | required to be paid, especially by a stated date | The remaining balance is payable within thirty days of the invoice date. | Số dư còn lại phải được thanh toán trong vòng ba mươi ngày kể từ ngày xuất hóa đơn. |
| penalty-n | penalty | a punishment or additional amount of money imposed for breaking a rule or failing to meet an obligation | A penalty will be charged if the equipment is returned after the due date. | Một khoản phạt sẽ được áp dụng nếu thiết bị được trả sau ngày đến hạn. |

# Vocabulary Quality Correction Batch 004 — v2.9.9

**Trạng thái:** Đã dry-run và áp dụng bằng `tools/patch-data.py`; đã chạy validator. Đây là working tree, chưa phải ZIP phát hành cuối.
**Nền dữ liệu:** v2.9.8, 928 ID; `baseDataVersion=2.9.8`; `idSetSha256` giữ nguyên.
**Phạm vi:** 40 headwords; sửa definition tiếng Anh và rà soát ví dụ/bản dịch theo ngữ cảnh TOEIC.
**Patch:** `patches/v2.9.9/batch-004.json` (120 thao tác).

Mỗi thao tác khóa theo ID, JSON Pointer và `expect.old`; trường definition còn kiểm tra POS. Patch hủy toàn batch nếu dữ liệu nền không khớp. Không thay đổi ID/POS/IPA/CEFR/schema hoặc dữ liệu cá nhân.

## Danh sách mục đã xử lý

| ID | Headword | Definition tiếng Anh mới | Ví dụ tiếng Anh | Bản dịch tiếng Việt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| performance-n | performance | how well a person, team, or organization carries out a task or achieves its goals | The quarterly report shows a significant improvement in employee performance. | Báo cáo quý cho thấy hiệu suất làm việc của nhân viên được cải thiện đáng kể. |
| perishable-adj | perishable | likely to decay or become unsafe to eat after a relatively short time | The warehouse stores perishable products in temperature-controlled rooms. | Kho hàng bảo quản các sản phẩm dễ hư hỏng trong những phòng có kiểm soát nhiệt độ. |
| portfolio-n | portfolio | a collection of investments, projects, or examples of work held or presented by a person or organization | The investment firm reviewed each client’s portfolio before recommending changes. | Công ty đầu tư đã xem xét danh mục đầu tư của từng khách hàng trước khi đề xuất điều chỉnh. |
| postage-n | postage | the fee charged for sending a letter or package through the postal service | The online order confirmation states that postage will be added to the final cost. | Xác nhận đơn hàng trực tuyến cho biết phí gửi bưu chính sẽ được cộng vào tổng chi phí. |
| postponement-n | postponement | the act of arranging for an event or activity to take place at a later time | Due to severe weather, the postponement of the outdoor event was announced this morning. | Do thời tiết khắc nghiệt, việc hoãn sự kiện ngoài trời đã được thông báo sáng nay. |
| precaution-n | precaution | an action taken in advance to reduce the risk of harm, damage, or an unwanted problem | As a precaution, all visitors must sign in at the reception desk. | Để phòng ngừa rủi ro, tất cả khách đến thăm phải đăng ký tại quầy lễ tân. |
| premium-n | premium | an amount paid regularly for an insurance policy, or an additional charge for a higher level of service | The company will pay the annual insurance premium for all full-time employees. | Công ty sẽ thanh toán phí bảo hiểm hằng năm cho tất cả nhân viên toàn thời gian. |
| prescribe-v | prescribe | to state officially what must be done or what treatment or procedure should be followed | The safety regulations prescribe a monthly inspection of all lifting equipment. | Quy định an toàn yêu cầu kiểm tra hằng tháng toàn bộ thiết bị nâng. |
| priority-n | priority | something that is considered more important than other matters and should be dealt with first | Resolving the customer’s billing issue is our top priority today. | Giải quyết vấn đề thanh toán của khách hàng là ưu tiên hàng đầu của chúng ta hôm nay. |
| productivity-n | productivity | the rate at which work is completed or goods and services are produced | The new scheduling system has increased productivity across the service department. | Hệ thống lập lịch mới đã nâng cao năng suất trên toàn bộ bộ phận dịch vụ. |
| proficiency-n | proficiency | a high level of skill or ability in a particular subject or activity | The position requires proficiency in business English and spreadsheet software. | Vị trí này yêu cầu trình độ thành thạo tiếng Anh thương mại và phần mềm bảng tính. |
| proficient-adj | proficient | having the skill and ability needed to do something well | Applicants must be proficient in using common office applications. | Ứng viên phải thành thạo việc sử dụng các ứng dụng văn phòng phổ biến. |
| prolong-v | prolong | to make an activity, situation, or period of time continue for longer than expected | A shortage of replacement parts could prolong the equipment repair. | Tình trạng thiếu linh kiện thay thế có thể kéo dài việc sửa chữa thiết bị. |
| prolonged-adj | prolonged | continuing for a longer period than is usual or expected | The airport issued an apology after prolonged delays disrupted several flights. | Sân bay đã đưa ra lời xin lỗi sau khi tình trạng chậm trễ kéo dài làm gián đoạn một số chuyến bay. |
| promptly-adv | promptly | quickly and without unnecessary delay | Please forward the signed contract to our legal department promptly. | Vui lòng nhanh chóng chuyển hợp đồng đã ký đến bộ phận pháp lý của chúng tôi. |
| provisional-adj | provisional | temporary and intended to be confirmed, changed, or replaced later | The provisional schedule will be finalized after all department managers respond. | Lịch trình tạm thời sẽ được chốt sau khi tất cả trưởng bộ phận phản hồi. |
| qualification-n | qualification | a skill, experience, or certificate that makes someone suitable for a particular job or activity | Applicants should list each relevant qualification on the application form. | Ứng viên nên liệt kê từng bằng cấp và năng lực phù hợp trong mẫu đơn ứng tuyển. |
| reconciliation-n | reconciliation | the process of comparing two sets of financial records to make sure that they agree | The accounting team performs a bank reconciliation at the end of every month. | Nhóm kế toán thực hiện đối chiếu ngân hàng vào cuối mỗi tháng. |
| recurring-adj | recurring | happening repeatedly, often at regular intervals | The finance department monitors recurring payments for all company subscriptions. | Bộ phận tài chính theo dõi các khoản thanh toán định kỳ cho tất cả thuê bao của công ty. |
| reimburse-v | reimburse | to repay someone for money they have spent on an approved expense | Employees can submit receipts to be reimbursed for business travel costs. | Nhân viên có thể nộp hóa đơn để được hoàn trả chi phí đi công tác. |
| reliable-adj | reliable | able to be trusted to work correctly or to provide consistent and accurate results | We need a reliable supplier that can deliver office materials on schedule. | Chúng tôi cần một nhà cung cấp đáng tin cậy có thể giao vật tư văn phòng đúng lịch. |
| renew-v | renew | to extend the period for which an agreement, license, or document remains valid | The tenant must renew the office lease before the end of December. | Người thuê phải gia hạn hợp đồng thuê văn phòng trước cuối tháng Mười Hai. |
| renewal-n | renewal | the process of extending the period for which an agreement, license, or document remains valid | The renewal of the maintenance contract was approved by the director. | Việc gia hạn hợp đồng bảo trì đã được giám đốc phê duyệt. |
| replacement-n | replacement | a person or thing that takes the place of another that is missing, damaged, or no longer suitable | A replacement printer will be delivered to the branch by Friday. | Một máy in thay thế sẽ được giao đến chi nhánh trước thứ Sáu. |
| requirement-n | requirement | something that is necessary or must be done to meet a rule, standard, or need | A valid identification card is a requirement for entering the secure area. | Thẻ căn cước hợp lệ là yêu cầu bắt buộc để vào khu vực an ninh. |
| reschedule-v | reschedule | to arrange for an event or appointment to take place at a different time or date | The coordinator had to reschedule the interview because the manager was unavailable. | Điều phối viên phải sắp xếp lại lịch phỏng vấn vì quản lý không thể tham dự. |
| revision-n | revision | a change made to something after it has been reviewed, or a version containing such changes | The latest revision of the employee handbook includes the updated leave policy. | Bản chỉnh sửa mới nhất của sổ tay nhân viên bao gồm chính sách nghỉ phép đã cập nhật. |
| specify-v | specify | to state or describe something clearly and exactly | Please specify the quantity and delivery address when placing your order. | Vui lòng ghi rõ số lượng và địa chỉ giao hàng khi đặt đơn. |
| subscribe-v | subscribe | to arrange to receive a publication or service, usually by paying regularly | Customers can subscribe to the monthly industry newsletter on our website. | Khách hàng có thể đăng ký nhận bản tin ngành hằng tháng trên trang web của chúng tôi. |
| subscription-n | subscription | an arrangement in which someone pays regularly to receive a service or publication | The annual software subscription includes technical support and security updates. | Gói thuê bao phần mềm hằng năm bao gồm hỗ trợ kỹ thuật và các bản cập nhật bảo mật. |
| sufficient-adj | sufficient | as much as is needed for a particular purpose; enough | Please allow sufficient time for the shipment to clear customs. | Vui lòng dành đủ thời gian để lô hàng hoàn tất thủ tục thông quan. |
| sufficiently-adv | sufficiently | to the degree that is needed or adequate for a particular purpose | The conference room is sufficiently large to accommodate all registered guests. | Phòng hội nghị đủ rộng để bố trí chỗ cho tất cả khách đã đăng ký. |
| surcharge-n | surcharge | an extra amount of money added to the usual price or basic charge | A fuel surcharge may apply to deliveries outside the metropolitan area. | Phụ phí nhiên liệu có thể được áp dụng cho các chuyến giao hàng ngoài khu vực đô thị. |
| suspend-v | suspend | to stop an activity, service, or privilege temporarily, often until a problem is resolved | The airline will suspend the route while runway repairs are underway. | Hãng hàng không sẽ tạm ngừng tuyến bay trong thời gian sửa chữa đường băng. |
| suspension-n | suspension | the temporary stopping of an activity, service, or privilege | The temporary suspension of deliveries was announced after the warehouse fire. | Việc tạm ngừng giao hàng đã được thông báo sau vụ cháy nhà kho. |
| transact-v | transact | to carry out business or financial activities, especially by exchanging money or information | Customers can transact securely through the bank’s mobile application. | Khách hàng có thể thực hiện giao dịch an toàn thông qua ứng dụng di động của ngân hàng. |
| transit-n | transit | the process of being moved from one place to another, especially during transportation | The shipment is currently in transit and is expected to reach the regional depot tomorrow. | Lô hàng hiện đang trong quá trình vận chuyển và dự kiến đến kho khu vực vào ngày mai. |
| turnover-n | turnover | the total value of sales made by a business during a period, or the rate at which employees leave and are replaced | The retailer reported a 12 percent increase in annual turnover. | Nhà bán lẻ báo cáo doanh thu hằng năm tăng 12 phần trăm. |
| undergo-v | undergo | to experience or be subjected to a process, examination, or change | All new employees must undergo safety training before starting work. | Tất cả nhân viên mới phải trải qua khóa đào tạo an toàn trước khi bắt đầu công việc. |
| validity-n | validity | the state of being legally or officially acceptable, or the period during which something remains valid | Please check the validity of your access permit before entering the facility. | Vui lòng kiểm tra hiệu lực của giấy phép ra vào trước khi vào cơ sở. |

- 928/928 ID còn nguyên; không thêm/xóa/đổi ID.
- Có 291 bản ghi chứa sense động từ; cả 291 đều có `verb_forms`, `v1` khớp headword và ít nhất một collocation.

# GitHub Actions CI Investigation — 11/11/2026

## Incident supplied by the user

- Repository: `vuphuc1996/Toeic`
- Workflow/check shown: `Validate TOEIC dictionary / validate (push)`
- Run: `42981524564`
- Job: `130392820806`
- Annotation: `Process completed with exit code 1`
- Reported elapsed time: 13 seconds
- Link supplied: `https://github.com/vuphuc1996/Toeic/actions/runs/42981524564/job/130392820806#step:14:37`

## What is confirmed locally on the v2.20.0 release candidate

1. `python tools/validate-data.py` completes with **PASS**: 928 records, 0 errors and 8 known legacy `FD001` warnings. These warnings are recorded in `tools/quality-baseline.json`; they are not new regressions and do not make the local validator exit non-zero.
2. `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_choice_history.py' -v` completes with **5/5 PASS**.
3. The checked-in local workflow `.github/workflows/validate-data.yml` defines a job named `validate` and runs separately named Python/unit-test/validator/audit steps. Its 14th declared step is `Unit tests — choice_history` (counting from `Checkout` as step 1).
4. The local workflow invokes `python tools/validate-data.py` under `Validate vocabulary data (structure, ID integrity, APP_SHELL, ratchet baseline)`; it does not invoke `npm run validate`.

## What is not yet confirmed

- The remote run's exact failing step and terminal output are not available from the one-line annotation.
- The commit SHA, workflow file revision and branch state used by run `42981524564` have not been independently read from GitHub.
- Therefore it is not yet possible to determine whether the remote failure came from a unit test, a validator, a stale/different workflow, a missing file, or a commit that did not contain the complete release package.
- The local pass does not prove that the remote commit has identical files.

## Impact assessment

- A failed Actions check does **not** revert a push. The commit normally remains on the branch.
- It does not itself mutate vocabulary JSON or IndexedDB data, and it does not by itself make the deployed website fail at runtime.
- It may block a protected-branch merge or a deployment pipeline only where branch protection or deployment dependencies require this check to pass.
- Whether GitHub Pages deployed this commit is unverified; do not infer deployment success or failure from this check alone.

## Required diagnostic sequence

1. Read the run's commit SHA and confirm that it is the intended v2.20.0 commit.
2. Expand the failed step and capture the complete command plus the first traceback/assertion/error lines, not only the generic job annotation.
3. Compare the workflow revision in that commit with `docs`/source package `.github/workflows/validate-data.yml`.
4. Reproduce the exact failing command against that exact commit; fix the actual defect without disabling the validation gate.
5. Commit the correction and rerun Actions. Record remote PASS only after a green run is visible.

GitHub's documented workflow-log procedure is to open the run, select the job, inspect the automatically expanded failed step, and copy/download the relevant log lines. The GitHub connector was suggested but is not yet installed/connected in this session, so direct remote log inspection remains blocked.

## Status

**IN PROGRESS — root cause unconfirmed.** Local vocabulary validation and local choice-history tests pass. No application code, vocabulary records, IndexedDB schema, or release version was changed as part of this investigation.

## Follow-up mapping after the V2.21.0 work

- The V2.20.0 local workflow was enumerated: declared step 14 is `Unit tests — choice_history`; step 21 is `Validate vocabulary data (structure, ID integrity, APP_SHELL, ratchet baseline)`. Thus, if the supplied `#step:14:37` link refers to this exact workflow revision, it points to the choice-history unit-test step rather than the vocabulary validator. This mapping is conditional on the remote run using the same workflow file revision.
- Local choice-history suite: **5/5 PASS**. Local vocabulary validator after V2.21.0 Batch 011: **0 ERROR / 0 WARNING**. These results do not prove what happened in the remote checkout.
- V2.21.0 has added `Unit tests — legacy_collocation_cleanup` as declared step 20; it does not change the meaning of step 14.

## V2.23.0 follow-up hardening (same date)

The remote incident above remains unconfirmed because the exact run log and commit SHA were not accessible. Subsequent local work found and corrected two independent test-maintenance issues in the V2.22/V2.23 source line:

1. The v2.19 second-pass registry used a whole-file SHA-256 for `data/listening/listening-library.json`. Intentional Part 1 transcript alignments and additive reserve content caused that guard to fail even when historical reviewed questions were unchanged. V2.23 replaces that brittle guard with per-question fingerprints and per-unit fingerprints (unit payload excludes the question array), explicitly records the five approved P1 alignment edits, and requires all out-of-registry questions to carry `reserve-pending-independent-review`.
2. The V2.23 reserve additions initially caused the historic answer-position balance test to include new P3/P4 items in the old 132-question certificate. The test now filters pending reserve items from the historic distribution while separately validating their choice count, unique options, and answer index.

The general Service Worker validator was also corrected so missing `OPTIONAL` paths do not raise structural errors; `APP_SHELL`/required resources remain strict. A separate `validate-part1-photo-assets.py` step remains strict and will fail CI unless all eight actual JPG files exist, match the attribution manifest and meet the minimum dimensions.

Local V2.23 status: 177/177 unit-test methods PASS; `validate-data.py` 0 errors/0 warnings; learning-content validator 0 errors / 8 warnings solely because the 8 JPG bytes are absent from the local snapshot; strict photo asset gate remains pending (0/8 local JPGs). This is a verified local repair of the newer source line, **not proof that it explains remote run 42981524564**. The remote commit/workflow/log still require direct confirmation.
