# Responsive Layout QA — v2.14.0

**Date:** 10 November 2026  
**Build:** TOEIC Dictionary v2.14.0  
**QA type:** automated/static regression and browser-attempt record; not physical-device certification.

## 1. Cross-device rules checked

| CSS viewport width | Intended device class | Navigation/layout behavior | QA evidence in this build |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 320–640 px | Android/iPhone | Sidebar hidden; five-item bottom navigation; safe-area bottom inset; one-column dense workspaces; 16 px input text | Static breakpoint and safe-area regression tests PASS; no screenshot/interaction run |
| 641–850 px | Compact tablet / iPad portrait | 76 px icon rail; phone bottom navigation hidden; fluid gutters and compact two-column dashboard | Static breakpoint and no-phone-nav tests PASS; no screenshot/interaction run |
| 851–1199 px | Tablet landscape / compact laptop | Compact full sidebar; no phone bottom navigation; flexible two-column dashboard | CSS/static breakpoint rules inspected; no screenshot/interaction run |
| ≥1200 px | Laptop / desktop / wide monitor | Full desktop navigation; content max width; flexible grid columns and large viewport gutters | Desktop uses base layout; no screenshot/interaction run |

## 2. Required viewport regression matrix

The release checklist defines the following target widths: **320, 360, 390, 430, 641, 768, 820, 1024, 1280, 1440 and 1920 CSS px**. This build contains automated checks for the breakpoint definitions, shared scale, safe-area behavior, touch sizing, stylesheet inclusion and PWA caching. It does **not** claim that each target width was visually rendered and inspected.

## 3. Typography and control audit

- Platform system font stack: iOS/macOS `-apple-system`/system UI, Windows `Segoe UI`, Android `Roboto` with `Noto Sans` fallback. No remote font download was added.
- Body: 15–16 px; page titles fluid 23–34 px; supporting/helper text target 12–14 px; eyebrow labels 11 px. A shared readability floor raises legacy 7–10 px micro-labels to at least 11 px.
- Primary/secondary and text buttons: minimum 44 px height; button copy normally 14–15 px. Inputs are 44 px minimum and 46 px on phones; mobile input text is 16 px.
- Icons normally 18–22 px; icon-only controls retain accessible names. Coarse-pointer icon actions, alphabet chips and row actions target 44 × 44 px.
- Focus-visible ring, disabled control state, tap feedback and high-contrast preference are present.

## 4. Motion and accessibility

- Page entry, button press, fine-pointer hover, card surface feedback, and progress changes have short transitions.
- Hover feedback is only enabled for fine pointers; touch users do not need hover to discover or use an action.
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` suppresses non-essential transitions/animations and disables smooth scrolling.
- `prefers-contrast: more` increases border and muted-text contrast.

## 5. Automated/static evidence

- `tools/tests/test_design_system.py`: **13/13 PASS**.
- `tools/tests/test_dashboard_layout.py`: **6/6 PASS**.
- Design-system stylesheet is linked after feature CSS and is included in `REQUIRED`/`APP_SHELL` service-worker lists; all 73 APP_SHELL paths exist.
- CSS parser: 0 parse errors. HTML: 206 IDs, 206 unique, 0 duplicates.
- No project Markdown files are outside `docs/`.

## 6. Browser/device limitation

A headless Chromium 144 preview was attempted against both the local preview route and a local file. The sandbox blocked local navigation/render execution (`ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR` / Chromium renderer termination); no trustworthy screenshot or computed-layout measurements were produced. Therefore this report does not claim browser screenshot QA, tap/keyboard interaction QA, text-clipping verification or no-overflow verification on a running browser.

Still pending: physical iPhone Safari, Android Chrome, iPadOS Safari, Windows/macOS desktop browsers, remote GitHub Actions and GitHub Pages deployment/cache QA. The 320–1920 CSS-pixel matrix must be captured in a functioning browser before calling cross-device visual QA complete.

# Responsive Sidebar Fix — v2.18.0

Ngày: 11/11/2026  
Phạm vi: desktop/laptop, đặc biệt viewport chiều cao thấp ở mức zoom 100%.

## Vấn đề

Ở một số laptop 15,6 inch (ví dụ viewport CSS gần 1366×768 sau khi tính vùng hiển thị của trình duyệt), menu bên trái có thể chiếm hết chiều cao. Khi đó khối thông tin cuối menu — **Dữ liệu cục bộ**, **Lưu riêng trên thiết bị**, và dòng phiên bản/host — bị đẩy ra ngoài hoặc không còn nhìn thấy ở mức zoom 100%.

## Thay đổi

- Tại desktop `min-width: 851px`, sidebar dùng `100dvh` (có fallback `100vh`) và không cho nội dung tràn khỏi khung sidebar.
- `.side-nav` trở thành vùng flex có `min-height: 0` và `overflow-y: auto`; khi menu dài, chỉ danh sách điều hướng cuộn.
- `.sidebar-bottom` không co lại, được đẩy xuống đáy sidebar và giữ nền riêng để không bị menu phủ lên.
- Khi chiều cao viewport ≤820 CSS px, giảm padding, khoảng cách menu và chiều cao dòng. Ở ≤680 CSS px, áp dụng compact mode mạnh hơn.
- Nội dung trạng thái cuối menu không bị `display:none`, không bị cắt chữ và không phụ thuộc vào zoom 90%.
- Không thay đổi hành vi icon rail tablet 641–850 px hoặc mobile navigation.

## Kiểm thử tĩnh

Hai regression tests được thêm vào `tools/tests/test_design_system.py` để kiểm tra footer sidebar luôn được giữ và nav có thể cuộn độc lập; cả hai nằm trong nhóm test nhanh đã PASS. Ngoài ra, script cuối xác nhận ba chuỗi trạng thái hiện diện trong `index.html`, 74/74 APP_SHELL path tồn tại và JavaScript/CSS liên quan không bị thay đổi ngoài dự kiến.

## Giới hạn xác minh

Chưa có trình duyệt đồ họa được phép chạy trong sandbox để chụp màn hình hoặc tương tác thật. Vì vậy **chưa tuyên bố đã xác minh trực quan ở zoom 100% trên laptop 15,6 inch**. Người dùng cần push/deploy rồi kiểm tra ở zoom 100%; nếu footer vẫn bị ẩn, cần ảnh chụp toàn màn hình kèm kích thước viewport để điều chỉnh theo đúng môi trường.

## Implemented changes

- Smart Review: after the learner confirms the explanation with OK, auto-next opens a dedicated waiting modal showing an animated loader, circular countdown, progress bar and status message. The modal cannot be dismissed by backdrop/Escape while waiting. The learner can cancel the countdown and use the manual Next button. Disabling auto-next closes the wait modal and enables manual navigation.
- Session restore: `practiceSession.autoAdvanceWaiting` restores the pending state and wait modal after reload. The progress-ring duration is reset to the configured 3/5/10-second delay, so its visual progress matches the real timer.
- Flashcard: container-aware layout stacks vertically when the available card width is narrow; fixed image aspect ratio, `object-fit: contain`, `min-width: 0`, bounded content and inner scrolling prevent long vocabulary details from widening the card. Wider cards retain a balanced two-column layout.
- TTS: if no male voice URI has been manually saved and the device offers `Daniel — en-GB`, it is preferred as the male fallback. A manually chosen URI retains priority; female default behavior is unchanged. The selected voice's own locale is applied to the utterance.
- Vocabulary and personal data: no base vocabulary records, IDs, schema or study progress were changed in this UX patch.

- `data/manifest.json`: version 2.10.1; all 8 version marker locations are synchronized.
- HTML: 201 IDs, all unique.

# TOEIC Dictionary v2.15.1 — Runtime Hotfix Test Report

- **Release:** v2.15.1 — Reading/Grammar Runtime Hotfix & CI Runner Maintenance
- **Date:** 10/11/2026
- **Baseline:** v2.15.0 Distractor Quality Audit
- **Scope:** fix undefined-variable rendering in Reading and Grammar; harden Part 5 card word count where no passage exists; update GitHub Actions action majors and runner pin. No content or personal progress schema changes.

## 1. Defect analysis and fixes

### Reading `ReferenceError: item is not defined`

`openReadingDetail(id)` iterates `reading.questions` and `q.choices` but used `item.part` in the choice template. There is no `item` binding in that function. The choice template now renders `escapeHtml(choice)` directly; Reading options are no longer suppressed by a Part 1-only conditional copied from Listening.

### Grammar sibling defect

`openGrammarLesson(id)` had the same out-of-scope `item.part` reference while rendering Grammar choices. It now renders `escapeHtml(choice)` directly.

### Part 5 Reading card fallback

Part 5 resources intentionally use incomplete sentences and do not require a `passage` field. The old fallback expression called `item.passage.split()` when `wordCount` was `0`, which could throw. The card renderer now derives text from `passage` or `documents[]` safely, then calculates a fallback word count without dereferencing an absent string.

## 2. Regression tests

`node --check assets/js/app.js`: PASS.

# Test Report — TOEIC Dictionary v2.25.0

**Release candidate:** Full TOEIC Mock Practice Beta / Batch 015  
**Base:** V2.24.0 Full Source  
**Date:** 11 November 2026

## Delivered scope

A dedicated Mock page provides a 15-minute / 25-question Quick Test, 60-minute / 100-question Half Test and 120-minute / 200-question Full Test. Each mode has separately timed Listening and Reading sections. The exam saves answers/flags locally, supports resume after refresh, auto-advances at the Listening deadline, auto-submits at the total deadline and displays per-skill and per-Part results.

## Content counts used

| Part | Current eligible bank | Full-test selection |
|---|---:|---:|
| Listening Part 1 | 8 | 6 |
| Listening Part 2 | 25 | 25 |
| Listening Part 3 | 39 | 39 |
| Listening Part 4 | 30 | 30 |
| **Listening** | **102** | **100** |
| Reading Part 5 | 30 | 30 |
| Reading Part 6 | 16 | 16 |
| Reading Part 7 single passage | 38 | 29 |
| Reading Part 7 multiple passage | 25 | 25 |
| **Reading** | **109** | **100** |

The 11 additional Batch 013 Listening reserve questions are not in the mock pool because they remain marked `reserve-pending-independent-review`.

## Format and behavior

| Mode | Listening timer | Reading timer | Total | Q count |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Quick | 05:22 | 09:38 | 15:00 | 25 |
| Half | 22:30 | 37:30 | 60:00 | 100 |
| Full | 45:00 | 75:00 | 120:00 | 200 |

The engine samples questions randomly and uses stable IDs to assert no duplicates inside a generated test. P3/P4 whole 3-question blocks, P6 whole 4-question blocks and Part 7 document blocks remain intact. A dedicated lifetime usage ledger (`toeic:mock-usage:v1`) records every generated test independently from the 60-row display history, so rotation does not forget older attempts. Existing attempt history is used to bootstrap/reconcile the ledger on upgrade. Questions that have never been selected are prioritized before previously used items. Since current pool counts exactly match Full Test targets for P2/P3/P4/P5/P6 and all P7 multiple-passage questions, later Full Tests can reuse content. `reusedQuestionCount` is displayed; the content bank must grow before promising multiple fully non-overlapping full tests.

UI includes question map and jump controls, answer selection, flags, section countdown, Listening-to-Reading transition, manual submit, timeout submit, answer explanations, transcript/passage review after completion, visually separated Listening/Reading score rings, raw correct counts, accuracy, distance to the 75% internal target and per-Part improvement guidance. Part 1 prefers JPG and handles load error by switching to its SVG fallback.

## Automated test results

- `node tools/tests/mock-exam-engine.mjs`: **PASS** — exact 25/100/200 questions, timers, Part distributions, unique IDs, grouped audio/passage blocks, excluded reserve content, history and lifetime-ledger rotation, deadlines and scoring.
- `node tools/tests/mock-ui-integrity.mjs`: **PASS** — unique HTML IDs, all three mode controls, split-skill report markup, lifetime-use storage key, no IndexedDB writes from Mock and required PWA resource.
- `node tools/tests/runtime-render-smoke.mjs`: **PASS** — existing Reading/Listening/Grammar render and migration regression.
- `node tools/tests/listening-tts-regression.mjs`: **PASS** — V2.24 TTS cancellation/voice behavior unchanged.
- `node --check` for app module, mock engine and Service Worker: **PASS**.
- HTML static ID check: **PASS** — 235 IDs, no duplicate IDs; all Mock-required IDs exist.
- Existing data, coverage, evidence, distractor and version validators are run separately and summarized after the final build below.

## Score integrity

The redesigned report shows separate Listening and Reading visual score rings, raw correct count out of the questions in that mode, percentage, unanswered count, and the additional correct answers needed to reach 75% for a comparable test. This is not a score out of 495. `75%` is an internal practice target for improvement guidance, not an ETS cutoff or CEFR estimate. No 10–990 score conversion is generated. ETS scores are scaled/equated; the current content pack has no reliable form-specific equating data.

## Storage boundary

Mock test data uses the isolated LocalStorage keys `toeic:mock-history:v1`, `toeic:mock-active:v1`, `toeic:mock-last-result:v1` and the dedicated lifetime rotation ledger `toeic:mock-usage:v1`. No new IndexedDB calls are made. DB `toeic-vocabulary-phase1` version 1, store `workspace`, 928 vocabulary IDs and all existing study progress are untouched. Personal profile import/export/inspection/reset/migration remains deferred and was not performed.

## Known limitations / QA not claimed

- Local source snapshot has no actual Part 1 JPG bytes (0/8). SVG fallbacks exist and the UI fallback path is implemented; strict photo gate remains pending on user's GitHub assets.
- Browser-render/interaction and 15.6-inch 100% zoom, iPhone Safari, Android Chrome and tablet QA are not certified in this release cycle.
- Remote GitHub Actions and Pages deploy are not verified.
- TOEIC teacher/independent editorial signoff is pending.
- Multiple Full Test forms with zero overlap require more reviewed content.

## Not tested / not claimed

- GitHub Actions on the remote repository was not run (no push performed).
- GitHub Pages deployment was not performed or verified.
- iPhone Safari, Android Chrome, tablet and other physical-device QA were not performed.
- v2.10.0 UX, Listening TTS and personal IndexedDB `baseSig` migration were not modified or tested in this release.

## Archived source: `docs/reports/TOEIC_DASHBOARD_LAYOUT_QA_v2.13.0.md`

# TOEIC Learning Diagnostics — Layout QA v2.13.0

- **Date:** 2026-11-10
- **Scope:** `#toeicProgressPanel` on the dashboard.
- **Status:** Static markup/CSS regression tests pass; real browser and physical-device visual QA remain pending.

## Layout changes

| Area | v2.12.0 issue | v2.13.0 treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Section wrapper | Generic `.panel` outer surface made the diagnostics block look like a nested boxed card | Removed exact `panel` class; section reads as an open content section |
| Header hierarchy | Eyebrow, main title and explanation crowded in a panel header | Separate eyebrow, H2 and short description |
| TOEIC scope | Listening and Reading content appeared as one large block | Two separately labeled groups with form question counts |
| Part tiles | Per-Part details were visually nested under the outer panel | Seven individually framed interactive cards remain the only framed metric tiles |
| Priority note | Recommendation looked like another content card | Lightweight left-accented note below both groups |

## Responsive and accessible behavior

- Two-column Listening/Reading layout at wide widths; stacked groups below 900px.
- Two-column Part card grid at narrow widths; min-width safeguards avoid grid overflow.
- Part tiles remain native buttons and retain `:focus-visible` outline.
- Priority recommendation retains `role="status"` and `aria-live="polite"`.
- Reduced-motion preference disables the card hover transition.
- Copy continues to identify diagnostics as internal learning indicators, not an ETS score conversion.

## Static test results

`tools/tests/test_dashboard_layout.py`: **6/6 PASS**. The tests assert that the wrapper is not a generic `.panel`, title hierarchy exists, Listening and Reading have separate mount points, priority status is accessible, tablet/mobile breakpoints exist, and Part tiles are keyboard-focusable with overflow safeguards.

## Visual QA limitation

A rendered screenshot and real browser interaction check could not be completed in the current sandbox because the headless browser navigation was blocked by the environment (`ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR`). Therefore no claim is made for pixel-perfect appearance on Chrome, Safari, iOS or Android. The user should complete the manual viewport checks in the release test report before production deployment.

# TOEIC Distractor & Answer-Uniqueness Audit — v2.15.0

## Scope and method
- Reviewed **132 questions** across Listening Part 3 (39), Listening Part 4 (30) and Reading Part 7 (63). This covers the 126 direct/lexical evidence pointers and six paraphrase/inference items identified in the v2.14.0 evidence map.
- Each question was examined with its full transcript or passage, keyed option and all three distractors. Review criteria: source support for the key, exactly one defensible answer, grammatical/semantic fit to the prompt, plausibility of distractors, and whether alternatives draw on realistic confusions or nearby details.
- Structural checks in this script verify four distinct options and a valid key. They do **not** certify semantic uniqueness by algorithm and are not a substitute for a second human reviewer or psychometric analysis.

## Reviewed coverage
| Library | Part | Sets | Questions |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Listening | Part 3 | 13 | 39 |

| Reading | Part 7 | 24 | 63 |

## Twelve distractor revisions applied
| Library / set / question | Editorial change |
|---|---|
| Listening · `part3-hotel-reservation` · Q1 | Replaced unrelated hotel-service alternatives with other plausible booking requests. |
| Listening · `part3-client-presentation` · Q3 | Aligned all alternatives with realistic presentation-preparation actions. |
| Listening · `part4-training-registration` · Q1 | Aligned alternatives as plausible employee groups. |
| Reading · `business-travel` · Q2 | Made all alternatives plausible travel records while keeping reimbursement evidence unique. |
| Reading · `customer-refund-email` · Q1 | Replaced the unrelated hotel refund with realistic keyboard/order-resolution requests. |
| Reading · `supplier-invoice-followup` · Q1 | Aligned alternatives with common invoice/payment verification issues. |
| Reading · `double-passage-order` · Q1 | Replaced off-topic alternatives with plausible causes of a shipment delay. |
| Reading · `part7-double-equipment-order` · Q1 | Aligned alternatives with realistic supplier/order enquiries. |
| Reading · `part7-single-training-email` · Q1 | Aligned alternatives as plausible employee audiences. |
| Reading · `training-announcement` · Q1 | Aligned alternatives as internal employee groups. |
| Reading · `part7-triple-regional-sales-meeting` · Q1 | Aligned alternatives with plausible meeting materials. |
| Reading · `part7-triple-facility-renovation` · Q3 | Aligned alternatives with plausible visitor-access arrangements. |

## Answer-position distribution — retained, not shuffled
| Part | A | B | C | D | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Part 3 | 10 | 18 | 10 | 1 | 39 |
| Part 4 | 9 | 12 | 7 | 2 | 30 |
| Part 7 | 13 | 27 | 19 | 4 | 63 |

**Important finding:** answer positions are currently uneven, especially D in Part 3/4/7. They were deliberately not shuffled in this release because `readingProgress` and `listeningProgress` currently persist `choiceIndex` (A/B/C/D index) against question order. Reordering choices without a stable choice identity and migration would make previously saved answers appear to point at a different option. A future release must first add stable `choiceId`/choice-text persistence and a legacy progress migration, then rebalance answer positions with regression tests.

## Quality decision and remaining limitations
- The 12 revised groups now use distractors closer to the same document purpose, role, travel record, service request, business action or visitor-access context. The correct answer text and `answerIndex` were kept unchanged for every revised question.
- Other reviewed groups were retained where the three alternatives are distinct and the transcript/passage supports one clear key. In particular, close dates/times, locations, meeting materials and process steps remain useful distractors when they are contradicted or not supported by the source.
- This is editorial review of original-authored content. It is not official ETS content, two-person independent review, statistical item analysis, difficulty calibration or proof of score equivalence.
- Part 1 remains SVG illustration-based; Listening audio remains browser SpeechSynthesis. Physical-device audio/voice review is still pending.

## Answer-position distribution — retained, not shuffled
| Part | A | B | C | D | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Part 3 | 10 | 18 | 10 | 1 | 39 |
| Part 4 | 9 | 12 | 7 | 2 | 30 |
| Part 7 | 13 | 27 | 19 | 4 | 63 |

**Important finding:** answer positions are currently uneven, especially D in Part 3/4/7. They were deliberately not shuffled in this release because `readingProgress` and `listeningProgress` currently persist `choiceIndex` (A/B/C/D index) against question order. Reordering choices without a stable choice identity and migration would make previously saved answers appear to point at a different option. A future release must first add stable `choiceId`/choice-text persistence and a legacy progress migration, then rebalance answer positions with regression tests.

## Quality decision and remaining limitations
- The 12 revised groups now use distractors closer to the same document purpose, role, travel record, service request, business action or visitor-access context. The correct answer text and `answerIndex` were kept unchanged for every revised question.
- Other reviewed groups were retained where the three alternatives are distinct and the transcript/passage supports one clear key. In particular, close dates/times, locations, meeting materials and process steps remain useful distractors when they are contradicted or not supported by the source.
- This is editorial review of original-authored content. It is not official ETS content, two-person independent review, statistical item analysis, difficulty calibration or proof of score equivalence.
- Part 1 remains SVG illustration-based; Listening audio remains browser SpeechSynthesis. Physical-device audio/voice review is still pending.

**Rebalancing method:** 27 question groups had only the keyed option exchanged with a distractor position: 8 in Part 3, 5 in Part 4 and 14 in Part 7. The answer text, source evidence, explanation, question IDs and question order were retained. Each changed question carries `previousChoices` and `previousChoiceIds` from v2.16.0; the matching `choiceIds` moved with the option. At startup, progress containing a v2.16 `choiceId` is relocated to its new index; older records without an ID are mapped through the v2.16 snapshot. The prior index is preserved in `previousChoiceIndex`. No random shuffle was used.

## Quality decision and remaining limitations
- The 12 revised groups now use distractors closer to the same document purpose, role, travel record, service request, business action or visitor-access context. The correct answer text and `answerIndex` were kept unchanged for every revised question.
- Other reviewed groups were retained where the three alternatives are distinct and the transcript/passage supports one clear key. In particular, close dates/times, locations, meeting materials and process steps remain useful distractors when they are contradicted or not supported by the source.
- This is editorial review of original-authored content. It is not official ETS content, two-person independent review, statistical item analysis, difficulty calibration or proof of score equivalence.
- Part 1 uses licensed Pexels photographs with local SVG fallbacks; Listening audio remains browser SpeechSynthesis. Physical-device audio/voice review is still pending.

# TOEIC Distractor & Answer-Uniqueness Audit — v2.25.0

- Reviewed **132 questions** across Listening Part 3 (39), Listening Part 4 (30) and Reading Part 7 (63). This covers the 126 direct/lexical evidence pointers and six paraphrase/inference items identified in the v2.14.0 evidence map.

## Archived source: `docs/reports/TOEIC_EDITORIAL_AUDIT_v2.13.0.md`

# TOEIC Editorial Audit — v2.13.0 (Pass 1)

- **Date:** 2026-11-10
- **Baseline:** v2.12.0
- **Scope:** 211 original TOEIC-style questions — 102 Listening and 109 Reading.
- **Status:** First audit pass completed with targeted editorial corrections; final semantic signoff remains open.

## Audit coverage

| Check | Scope | Result |
|---|---:|---|
| Listening question objects | 102 | Scanned |
| Reading question objects | 109 | Scanned |
| Duplicate option text within an item | 211 items | 0 exact duplicates found after correction |
| Answer choice indexes | 211 | Validated by learning-content validator |
| Rationale text | 211 | Vietnamese wording check strengthened; all tests pass |
| Part 1 illustration consistency | 8 | Prompt now correctly says “illustration”; 8 image-specific rationales name A–D |
| Part 2 invoice distractor quality | 1 targeted item | Reworked two overlapping options |

The automated language gate checks for Vietnamese diacritics **and** Vietnamese explanatory/connective words. This prevents an accented English token such as “résumé” from being treated as a Vietnamese explanation. The gate is a practical regression check, not a full language classifier.

## Corrections recorded

1. `part1-meeting-documents`, `part1-warehouse-box`, `part1-technician-inspection`, `part1-airport-suitcase`, `part1-presentation-room`, `part1-reception-plant`, `part1-restaurant-setting`, `part1-photocopier`: the learner prompt no longer calls SVG illustrations photographs; runtime/CSS naming now uses illustration semantics. Explanations remain specific to each image and identify its correct option letter.
2. `part2-invoice-approval`: removed two distractors that both pointed to the revised total on page two; alternatives now represent distinct invoice workflow actions.
3. `part2-supplier-samples`: changed the tag question to “The supplier promised …, didn't they?” and the response to “They did, but …” to make the agreement unambiguous.
4. `part2-contract-review`: retained an explicit “Yes” plus the fact that final comments were sent, making completed review status clear.
5. Selected Part 2/3/4 explanations were expanded or rewritten in Vietnamese when they were terse or merely repeated an English clue.
6. Remaining legacy English Reading rationales were localized; selected P5/P6/P7 rationales now explain the grammatical, textual or document clue more directly.

## What this audit does not certify

- A string-level scan cannot prove that a transcript or document logically entails every keyed answer.
- A Vietnamese-word heuristic cannot judge translation quality, pedagogy or naturalness.
- It is not an external instructor/native-speaker review and does not establish psychometric difficulty or distractor discrimination.
- Part 1 remains SVG illustration content, and Listening remains browser SpeechSynthesis, not licensed photography or recorded/ETS audio.

## Next editorial gate

Pass 2 must independently cross-check every answer key against the actual transcript or source document(s), especially Part 7 cross-document questions and Part 5 grammar contrasts. Record each verified/corrected stable item ID. Only after that gate should the content pool be approved for Full Mock assembly.

## Corrected issues in this batch
- The Part 2 `part2-supplier-samples` display prompt was changed to the standard response-selection instruction so it no longer duplicates/rephrases the spoken question.
- All 23 generic Part 2 transcript-translation placeholders were replaced with Vietnamese translations of the actual spoken line.
- `part2-room-unavailable` now uses “That’s right…” to confirm the negative-tag statement without relying on a potentially confusing “Yes” response.

## Remaining audit work
- Review distractor plausibility and uniqueness across the 126 direct/lexical-evidence items; exact phrase overlap alone does not establish that the other three choices are clearly wrong.
- Verify browser audio playback, pacing and pronunciation on physical iPhone/iPad and Android voice packs; the current TTS remains browser-generated.
- Consider a second independent reviewer before releasing a scored mock. No official ETS scoring equivalence is claimed.

# TOEIC Editorial Evidence Audit — v2.15.0

## Scope and interpretation
- Questions indexed: **211** (102 Listening + 109 Reading).
- Every correct option is linked to its source transcript/passage or an explicit review category.
- Direct/lexical matching is evidence discovery only. It does not prove that distractors are wrong or that a paraphrase/inference is unique.
- In this editorial pass, 6 low-overlap paraphrase/inference items were checked against their transcript/passage; 8 Part 1 visual keys, all 25 Part 2 response-fit items, all 30 Part 5 grammar items and all 16 Part 6 context-fit items were also reviewed.
- These are internal editorial checks, not two-person independent proofreading, psychometric validation or ETS approval.

## Coverage by evidence type
| Library | Evidence category | Questions |
|---|---|---:|
| Listening | Direct source phrase | 32 |
| Listening | Source lexical evidence (paraphrase may remain) | 34 |
| Listening | Manual paraphrase/inference checked against source | 3 |
| Listening | Part 1 illustration/key comparison checked | 8 |
| Listening | Part 2 speech-act / response-fit checked | 25 |
| Reading | Direct source phrase | 34 |
| Reading | Source lexical evidence (paraphrase may remain) | 26 |
| Reading | Manual paraphrase/inference checked against source | 3 |
| Reading | Part 5 sentence grammar checked | 30 |
| Reading | Part 6 context/cohesion checked | 16 |

## Editorial review record
The following sections record categories reviewed manually during this pass. Direct/lexical categories remain source-evidence pointers; distractor plausibility and uniqueness for the 126 direct/lexical items plus six inference/paraphrase items were reviewed in v2.15.0 (see the separate distractor audit report).

## Remaining audit work
- Distractor plausibility and uniqueness for the 126 direct/lexical-evidence items plus six inference/paraphrase items were reviewed in v2.15.0; see `TOEIC_DISTRACTOR_AUDIT_v2.15.0.md`.
- Verify browser audio playback, pacing and pronunciation on physical iPhone/iPad and Android voice packs; the current TTS remains browser-generated.
- Obtain a second independent reviewer before releasing a scored mock. No official ETS scoring equivalence is claimed.

# TOEIC Editorial Evidence Audit — v2.16.0

## Scope and interpretation
- Questions indexed: **211** (102 Listening + 109 Reading).
- Every correct option is linked to its source transcript/passage or an explicit review category.
- Direct/lexical matching is evidence discovery only. It does not prove that distractors are wrong or that a paraphrase/inference is unique.
- In this editorial pass, 6 low-overlap paraphrase/inference items were checked against their transcript/passage; 8 Part 1 visual keys, all 25 Part 2 response-fit items, all 30 Part 5 grammar items and all 16 Part 6 context-fit items were also reviewed.
- These are internal editorial checks, not two-person independent proofreading, psychometric validation or ETS approval.

## Coverage by evidence type
| Library | Evidence category | Questions |
|---|---|---:|
| Listening | Direct source phrase | 32 |
| Listening | Source lexical evidence (paraphrase may remain) | 34 |

| Listening | Part 1 illustration/key comparison checked | 8 |
| Listening | Part 2 speech-act / response-fit checked | 25 |
| Reading | Direct source phrase | 34 |

| Reading | Manual paraphrase/inference checked against source | 3 |
| Reading | Part 5 sentence grammar checked | 30 |
| Reading | Part 6 context/cohesion checked | 16 |

# TOEIC Editorial Evidence Audit — v2.17.0

## Scope and interpretation
- Questions indexed: **211** (102 Listening + 109 Reading).
- Every correct option is linked to its source transcript/passage or an explicit review category.
- Direct/lexical matching is evidence discovery only. It does not prove that distractors are wrong or that a paraphrase/inference is unique.
- In this editorial pass, 6 low-overlap paraphrase/inference items were checked against their transcript/passage; 8 Part 1 visual keys, all 25 Part 2 response-fit items, all 30 Part 5 grammar items and all 16 Part 6 context-fit items were also reviewed.
- These are internal editorial checks, not two-person independent proofreading, psychometric validation or ETS approval.

- The Part 2 `part2-supplier-samples` display prompt was changed to the standard response-selection instruction so it no longer duplicates/rephrases the spoken question.
- All 23 generic Part 2 transcript-translation placeholders were replaced with Vietnamese translations of the actual spoken line.
- `part2-room-unavailable` now uses “That’s right…” to confirm the negative-tag statement without relying on a potentially confusing “Yes” response.

- The original 132-item distractor review was completed in v2.15.0; current answer-position distribution and stable-choice mapping are recorded in `TOEIC_DISTRACTOR_AUDIT_v2.17.0.md`.
- Verify browser audio playback, pacing and pronunciation on physical iPhone/iPad and Android voice packs; the current TTS remains browser-generated.
- Obtain a second independent reviewer before releasing a scored mock. No official ETS scoring equivalence is claimed.

# TOEIC Editorial Evidence Audit — v2.18.0

## Scope and interpretation
- Questions indexed: **211** (102 Listening + 109 Reading).
- Every correct option is linked to its source transcript/passage or an explicit review category.
- Direct/lexical matching is evidence discovery only. It does not prove that distractors are wrong or that a paraphrase/inference is unique.
- In this editorial pass, 6 low-overlap paraphrase/inference items were checked against their transcript/passage; 8 Part 1 visual keys, all 25 Part 2 response-fit items, all 30 Part 5 grammar items and all 16 Part 6 context-fit items were also reviewed.
- These are internal editorial checks, not two-person independent proofreading, psychometric validation or ETS approval.

|---|---|---:|
| Listening | Direct source phrase | 32 |

| Reading | Part 5 sentence grammar checked | 30 |

# TOEIC Editorial Evidence Audit — v2.19.0

## Scope and interpretation
- Questions indexed: **211** (102 Listening + 109 Reading).
- Every correct option is linked to its source transcript/passage or an explicit review category.
- Direct/lexical matching is evidence discovery only. It does not prove that distractors are wrong or that a paraphrase/inference is unique.
- In this editorial pass, 6 low-overlap paraphrase/inference items were checked against their transcript/passage; 8 Part 1 visual keys, all 25 Part 2 response-fit items, all 30 Part 5 grammar items and all 16 Part 6 context-fit items were also reviewed.
- These are internal editorial checks, not two-person independent proofreading, psychometric validation or ETS approval.

- The Part 2 `part2-supplier-samples` display prompt was changed to the standard response-selection instruction so it no longer duplicates/rephrases the spoken question.
- All 23 generic Part 2 transcript-translation placeholders were replaced with Vietnamese translations of the actual spoken line.
- `part2-room-unavailable` now uses “That’s right…” to confirm the negative-tag statement without relying on a potentially confusing “Yes” response.

## Remaining audit work
- The original 132-item distractor review was completed in v2.15.0; current answer-position distribution and stable-choice mapping are recorded in `TOEIC_DISTRACTOR_AUDIT_v2.19.0.md`.
- Verify browser audio playback, pacing and pronunciation on physical iPhone/iPad and Android voice packs; the current TTS remains browser-generated.
- Obtain a second independent reviewer before releasing a scored mock. No official ETS scoring equivalence is claimed.

# TOEIC Editorial Evidence Audit — v2.20.0

## Scope and interpretation
- Questions indexed: **211** (102 Listening + 109 Reading).
- Every correct option is linked to its source transcript/passage or an explicit review category.
- Direct/lexical matching is evidence discovery only. It does not prove that distractors are wrong or that a paraphrase/inference is unique.
- In this editorial pass, 6 low-overlap paraphrase/inference items were checked against their transcript/passage; 8 Part 1 visual keys, all 25 Part 2 response-fit items, all 30 Part 5 grammar items and all 16 Part 6 context-fit items were also reviewed.
- These are internal editorial checks, not two-person independent proofreading, psychometric validation or ETS approval.

## Coverage by evidence type
| Library | Evidence category | Questions |
|---|---|---:|
| Listening | Direct source phrase | 32 |
| Listening | Source lexical evidence (paraphrase may remain) | 34 |
| Listening | Manual paraphrase/inference checked against source | 3 |
| Listening | Part 1 illustration/key comparison checked | 8 |
| Listening | Part 2 speech-act / response-fit checked | 25 |
| Reading | Direct source phrase | 34 |
| Reading | Source lexical evidence (paraphrase may remain) | 26 |
| Reading | Manual paraphrase/inference checked against source | 3 |
| Reading | Part 5 sentence grammar checked | 30 |
| Reading | Part 6 context/cohesion checked | 16 |

The current answer-position and option-identity audit is maintained separately in `TOEIC_DISTRACTOR_AUDIT_v2.20.0.md`.

- Obtain a second independent reviewer before releasing a scored mock. No official ETS scoring equivalence is claimed.

# TOEIC Editorial Evidence Audit — v2.21.0

## Scope and interpretation
- Questions indexed: **211** (102 Listening + 109 Reading).
- Every correct option is linked to its source transcript/passage or an explicit review category.
- Direct/lexical matching is evidence discovery only. It does not prove that distractors are wrong or that a paraphrase/inference is unique.
- In this editorial pass, 6 low-overlap paraphrase/inference items were checked against their transcript/passage; 8 Part 1 visual keys, all 25 Part 2 response-fit items, all 30 Part 5 grammar items and all 16 Part 6 context-fit items were also reviewed.
- These are internal editorial checks, not two-person independent proofreading, psychometric validation or ETS approval.

- The Part 2 `part2-supplier-samples` display prompt was changed to the standard response-selection instruction so it no longer duplicates/rephrases the spoken question.
- All 23 generic Part 2 transcript-translation placeholders were replaced with Vietnamese translations of the actual spoken line.
- `part2-room-unavailable` now uses “That’s right…” to confirm the negative-tag statement without relying on a potentially confusing “Yes” response.

## Remaining audit work
- The original 132-item distractor review was completed in v2.15.0; current answer-position distribution and stable-choice mapping are recorded in `TOEIC_DISTRACTOR_AUDIT_v2.21.0.md`.
- Verify browser audio playback, pacing and pronunciation on physical iPhone/iPad and Android voice packs; the current TTS remains browser-generated.
- Obtain a second independent reviewer before releasing a scored mock. No official ETS scoring equivalence is claimed.

# TOEIC Editorial Evidence Audit — v2.22.0

## Scope and interpretation
- Questions indexed: **211** (102 Listening + 109 Reading).
- Every correct option is linked to its source transcript/passage or an explicit review category.
- Direct/lexical matching is evidence discovery only. It does not prove that distractors are wrong or that a paraphrase/inference is unique.
- In this editorial pass, 6 low-overlap paraphrase/inference items were checked against their transcript/passage; 8 Part 1 visual keys, all 25 Part 2 response-fit items, all 30 Part 5 grammar items and all 16 Part 6 context-fit items were also reviewed.
- These are internal editorial checks, not two-person independent proofreading, psychometric validation or ETS approval.

## Coverage by evidence type
| Library | Evidence category | Questions |
|---|---|---:|
| Listening | Direct source phrase | 32 |
| Listening | Source lexical evidence (paraphrase may remain) | 34 |
| Listening | Manual paraphrase/inference checked against source | 3 |
| Listening | Part 1 licensed photograph/key comparison checked | 8 |
| Listening | Part 2 speech-act / response-fit checked | 25 |
| Reading | Direct source phrase | 34 |
| Reading | Source lexical evidence (paraphrase may remain) | 26 |
| Reading | Manual paraphrase/inference checked against source | 3 |
| Reading | Part 5 sentence grammar checked | 30 |
| Reading | Part 6 context/cohesion checked | 16 |

# TOEIC Editorial Evidence Audit — v2.23.0

## Scope and interpretation
- Questions indexed: **222** (113 Listening + 109 Reading).
- Every correct option is linked to its source transcript/passage or an explicit review category.
- Direct/lexical matching is evidence discovery only. It does not prove that distractors are wrong or that a paraphrase/inference is unique.
- In this editorial pass, 6 low-overlap paraphrase/inference items were checked against their transcript/passage; 8 Part 1 Pexels source descriptions, all 30 Part 2 response-fit items, all 30 Part 5 grammar items and all 16 Part 6 context-fit items were also reviewed.
- Batch 013 adds 11 reserve Listening questions. They are included in the inventory/evidence index, but are not part of the 132-question Part 3/4/7 independent distractor-balance certificate until a separate review.
- These are internal editorial checks, not two-person independent proofreading, psychometric validation or ETS approval.

- The Part 2 `part2-supplier-samples` display prompt was changed to the standard response-selection instruction so it no longer duplicates/rephrases the spoken question.

- `part2-room-unavailable` now uses “That’s right…” to confirm the negative-tag statement without relying on a potentially confusing “Yes” response.

- The original 132-item distractor review was completed in v2.15.0; current answer-position distribution and stable-choice mapping are recorded in `TOEIC_DISTRACTOR_AUDIT_v2.23.0.md`.
- Verify browser audio playback, pacing and pronunciation on physical iPhone/iPad and Android voice packs; the current TTS remains browser-generated.
- Obtain a second independent reviewer before releasing a scored mock. No official ETS scoring equivalence is claimed.

# TOEIC Editorial Evidence Audit — v2.24.0

## Scope and interpretation
- Questions indexed: **222** (113 Listening + 109 Reading).
- Every correct option is linked to its source transcript/passage or an explicit review category.

- The Part 2 `part2-supplier-samples` display prompt was changed to the standard response-selection instruction so it no longer duplicates/rephrases the spoken question.
- All 23 generic Part 2 transcript-translation placeholders were replaced with Vietnamese translations of the actual spoken line.
- `part2-room-unavailable` now uses “That’s right…” to confirm the negative-tag statement without relying on a potentially confusing “Yes” response.

- The original 132-item distractor review was completed in v2.15.0; current answer-position distribution and stable-choice mapping are recorded in `TOEIC_DISTRACTOR_AUDIT_v2.24.0.md`.
- Verify browser audio playback, pacing and pronunciation on physical iPhone/iPad and Android voice packs; the current TTS remains browser-generated.
- Obtain a second independent reviewer before releasing a scored mock. No official ETS scoring equivalence is claimed.

# TOEIC Editorial Evidence Audit — v2.25.0

## Scope and interpretation
- Questions indexed: **222** (113 Listening + 109 Reading).
- Every correct option is linked to its source transcript/passage or an explicit review category.
- Direct/lexical matching is evidence discovery only. It does not prove that distractors are wrong or that a paraphrase/inference is unique.
- In this editorial pass, 6 low-overlap paraphrase/inference items were checked against their transcript/passage; 8 Part 1 Pexels source descriptions, all 30 Part 2 response-fit items, all 30 Part 5 grammar items and all 16 Part 6 context-fit items were also reviewed.
- Batch 013 adds 11 reserve Listening questions. They are included in the inventory/evidence index, but are not part of the 132-question Part 3/4/7 independent distractor-balance certificate until a separate review.
- These are internal editorial checks, not two-person independent proofreading, psychometric validation or ETS approval.

## Coverage by evidence type
| Library | Evidence category | Questions |
|---|---|---:|
| Listening | Direct source phrase | 33 |
| Listening | Source lexical evidence (paraphrase may remain) | 39 |
| Listening | Manual paraphrase/inference checked against source | 3 |
| Listening | Part 1 Pexels source description and keyed action reviewed | 8 |
| Listening | Part 2 speech-act / response-fit checked | 30 |
| Reading | Direct source phrase | 34 |
| Reading | Source lexical evidence (paraphrase may remain) | 26 |
| Reading | Manual paraphrase/inference checked against source | 3 |
| Reading | Part 5 sentence grammar checked | 30 |
| Reading | Part 6 context/cohesion checked | 16 |

The current answer-position and option-identity audit is maintained separately in `TOEIC_DISTRACTOR_AUDIT_v2.25.0.md`.

## Corrected issues in this batch
- The Part 2 `part2-supplier-samples` display prompt was changed to the standard response-selection instruction so it no longer duplicates/rephrases the spoken question.
- All 23 generic Part 2 transcript-translation placeholders were replaced with Vietnamese translations of the actual spoken line.
- `part2-room-unavailable` now uses “That’s right…” to confirm the negative-tag statement without relying on a potentially confusing “Yes” response.

## Remaining audit work
- The original 132-item distractor review was completed in v2.15.0; current answer-position distribution and stable-choice mapping are recorded in `TOEIC_DISTRACTOR_AUDIT_v2.25.0.md`.
- Verify browser audio playback, pacing and pronunciation on physical iPhone/iPad and Android voice packs; the current TTS remains browser-generated.
- Obtain a second independent reviewer before releasing a scored mock. No official ETS scoring equivalence is claimed.

# TOEIC Reading Part 7 — Internal Second-pass Review v2.18.0

Ngày: 11/11/2026  
Phạm vi: toàn bộ 63 câu thuộc 24 bộ Reading Part 7.

## Mục tiêu và phương pháp

Rà soát lần hai tính nhất quán giữa câu hỏi, tài liệu nguồn, mốc thời gian, đáp án đúng, distractor và phần giải thích. Với bộ nhiều tài liệu, đối chiếu các chi tiết trong từng document; không xem việc trùng từ khóa đơn thuần là bằng chứng đủ.

Đây là vòng tự rà soát nội bộ bổ sung, không phải kiểm định độc lập bởi chuyên gia bên ngoài, không phải hiệu chuẩn psychometric và không phải xác nhận/ủy quyền của ETS.

## Hai hiệu chỉnh nguồn

### 1. `part7-triple-conference-arrangements`

- Vấn đề: chi tiết đặt phòng trước đó không làm rõ được hai đêm lưu trú của hai khách và thời điểm Ms. Patel rời đi vào sáng 19/4.
- Hiệu chỉnh: xác nhận hai phòng còn lại đặt cho các đêm 17 và 18/4; phòng của Ms. Patel giữ đến lúc bà rời đi sau phiên họp sáng 19/4. Đồng bộ passage độc lập, bản dịch tiếng Việt và giải thích câu liên quan.
- Đáp án câu hỏi về ngày rời đi vẫn là **April 19**.

### 2. `part7-double-training-reimbursement`

- Vấn đề: ngày hoàn thành khóa học nằm trước ngày chương trình hoàn phí có hiệu lực, khiến điều kiện nộp hồ sơ chưa rõ có áp dụng hồi tố không.
- Hiệu chỉnh: chuyển ngày hoàn thành khóa học sang **July 18**, sau ngày chương trình bắt đầu **July 1**; chỉnh câu hỏi email để thể hiện ứng viên nộp hồ sơ sau khi chương trình có hiệu lực.
- Quyết định chấp thuận từ tháng 5 vẫn được giữ như thông tin phê duyệt trước; đáp án không đổi.

## Bảo toàn ngân hàng câu hỏi

- 63 câu / 24 bộ Part 7 vẫn giữ nguyên.
- Không đổi question ID, thứ tự câu hỏi, text lựa chọn, `choiceIds`, `answerIndex`, đáp án đúng hoặc vị trí lựa chọn.
- Phân bố vị trí đáp án vẫn A16/B16/C16/D15.
- Learning-content validator xác nhận Reading 109 câu, không lỗi/cảnh báo. Evidence audit vẫn bao phủ tổng 211 câu Listening/Reading.

## Điểm cần mở rộng ở batch nội dung sau

Hai bộ `double-passage-order` và `triple-passage-meeting` hiện mỗi bộ chỉ có một câu hỏi, và câu hỏi hiện có không yêu cầu tích hợp thông tin từ toàn bộ các tài liệu. Chưa phát hiện sai key; tuy nhiên chúng chưa phải mẫu luyện multi-document reasoning đủ chiều sâu. Giữ nguyên hiện trạng và đưa vào danh sách bổ sung câu hỏi dự trữ, thay vì tăng số câu trong lần sửa nguồn này.

## Kết luận

Vòng nội bộ lần hai đã rà đủ 63 câu và sửa hai điểm mơ hồ về timeline nguồn. Không có thay đổi đáp án/ID/thứ tự. Cần thêm reviewer con người độc lập trước khi đưa ngân hàng vào Full Mock có điểm số.

# TOEIC Listening & Reading — Remaining Content Second-pass Review v2.19.0

Ngày: 11/11/2026  
Trạng thái: hoàn tất vòng tự rà soát nội bộ; không thay đổi nội dung câu hỏi.

## Phạm vi

Rà soát toàn bộ **148 câu không thuộc Part 7**: Listening 102 câu (P1=8, P2=25, P3=39, P4=30) và Reading 46 câu (P5=30, P6=16). Part 7 gồm 63 câu đã có báo cáo second-pass riêng trong v2.18.0. Tổng ngân hàng Listening/Reading vẫn là 211 câu.

## Tiêu chí rà soát

- **Part 1:** đối chiếu chi tiết trong hình minh họa SVG với câu mô tả và phương án; giữ nhãn illustration, không mô tả đây là ảnh chụp.
- **Part 2:** xác định loại câu hỏi/hành động lời nói (WH-, yes/no, lựa chọn, đề nghị, xác nhận, phản hồi gián tiếp) và độ tự nhiên/liên quan của câu trả lời; distractor phải không trả lời đúng ý định giao tiếp.
- **Part 3–4:** đối chiếu từng key với transcript, người nói, thời gian, địa điểm, mục đích và bước tiếp theo; kiểm tra các phương án nhiễu không tạo ra key thứ hai hoặc mâu thuẫn transcript.
- **Part 5:** kiểm tra cấu trúc câu, từ loại, hòa hợp chủ-vị, thì, bị động, so sánh, liên từ/giới từ; chỉ giữ key khi có một lựa chọn tốt nhất theo ngữ cảnh.
- **Part 6:** kiểm tra ngữ pháp ở vị trí trống, liên kết câu/đoạn, trình tự logic và tính phù hợp của câu chèn; giải thích phải nêu được mối liên hệ.
- Đối chiếu lại lựa chọn đúng và giải thích tiếng Việt; giữ nguyên định danh lựa chọn (`choiceIds`).

## Kết quả

Không phát hiện lỗi nội dung đủ căn cứ để sửa mà không có nguy cơ làm giảm độ chính xác. Vì vậy batch này **giữ nguyên key và nội dung**, không sửa chỉ để tạo khác biệt phiên bản. Không thay đổi `answerIndex`, text phương án, `choiceIds`, thứ tự câu hỏi hoặc số lượng câu. Kết quả bảo thủ này không có nghĩa là nội dung đã được chuyên gia độc lập hoặc ETS chứng nhận.

| Part | Số câu | Kết quả |

| Listening P3 | 39 | Rà transcript / speaker / timeline / distractor; giữ nguyên |
| Listening P4 | 30 | Rà transcript / detail / inference / distractor; giữ nguyên |

Các mã dưới đây dùng định danh ổn định dạng `unitId#Qn` vì dữ liệu hiện tại chưa gán question ID độc lập cho từng câu. # v2.9.10 — Verb Forms & Collocations Review

- Base: v2.9.9; total records: 928; unique IDs: 928; ID-set SHA-256: `dd1705e64c8df4ad7ebca188a6ad856fff1d180d99730d2d77d2ba6fbdc12656`.
- Missing verb forms after POS/sense audit: 122 records. All contain at least one sense whose POS tokens include `v`.
- Curated collocations added to 39 records (two phrases each; only where the record previously had an empty list).
- POS-only noun records were not assigned verb forms. Existing 169 verb-form records were not rewritten.
- Spelling convention: US English, consistent with the dataset phonetic field `us`.

## Irregular forms checked against dictionary entries

| Headword | Third-person | Past | Past participle | -ing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| foresee | foresees | foresaw | foreseen | foreseeing |
| undergo | undergoes | underwent | undergone | undergoing |
| underwrite | underwrites | underwrote | underwritten | underwriting |
| withhold | withholds | withheld | withheld | withholding |

Sources: Cambridge Dictionary entries for [foresee](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/foresee) and [undergo](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/undergo); Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries entries for [underwrite](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/underwrite), [withhold](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/withhold), and [incur](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/incur).

Regular forms follow standard US English inflection rules. For debated spelling variants, this project uses `benefited/benefiting` and `channeled/channeling`; accepted alternatives are intentionally not duplicated in this compact five-field schema.

## Patch batches

- `patches/v2.9.10/batch-001.json`: 31 verb-form records; 10 collocation lists updated.
- `patches/v2.9.10/batch-002.json`: 31 verb-form records; 8 collocation lists updated.
- `patches/v2.9.10/batch-003.json`: 31 verb-form records; 12 collocation lists updated.
- `patches/v2.9.10/batch-004.json`: 29 verb-form records; 9 collocation lists updated.

All operations use `expect.old`, the base version and the SHA-256 of the complete ID set. Verb-related changes also require `expect.verbSense=true`.

# Vocabulary quality review — v2.9.11 Batch 001

**Base:** v2.9.10  
**Target:** v2.9.11  
**Date:** 2026-11-09  
**Data scope:** 928 fixed headwords; no new IDs.

## Changes delivered

| Area | Operations | Result |
|---|---:|---|
| US IPA | 31 | 7 malformed entries corrected; 24 missing IPA values populated from Cambridge Dictionary |
| Word families | 49 | Coverage 74 → 122 records |
| Competitor synonyms / CEFR | 4 | `challenger`, `contender`, `rival`; CEFR A2 → B1 |
| Related-term glossary | 2 new glossary entries | 345 → 347 terms |

### IPA quality

The 7 corrected records are `buyer-n`, `consider-v`, `deliver-v`, `difference-n`, `employer-n`, `estimate-nv`, and `transfer-nv`. The 24 new transcriptions are `capacity`, `catalogue`, `certificate`, `certification`, `certify`, `circulate`, `clarify`, `clerk`, `commission`, `commodity`, `compensation`, `competitive`, `competitor`, `comply`, `authorization`, `arrangement`, `consultant`, `consultation`, `application`, `applicable`, `attendance`, `attendee`, `recruitment`, and `manufacturer`. All source URLs are listed in `SOURCES_TOEIC_Dictionary_v2.9.11.md`.

`estimate` has distinct noun and verb pronunciations. As `phonetic.us` accepts one string, the noun pronunciation is stored for the first/primary sense; POS-specific IPA remains a known schema/UI limitation.

### Word-family review

The 49 affected records form these reviewed clusters where the corresponding headwords exist: apply/applicant/application/applicable; arrange/arrangement; attendance/attendee; benefit/beneficial/beneficiary; comply/compliance; consultancy/consultant/consultation; deliver/deliverable/delivery; employee/employer/employment; manage/manager; manufacture/manufacturer; produce/product/productivity; recruit/recruitment; respond/response; supply/supplier; authorize/authorization; confirm/confirmation; coordinate/coordinator; negotiate/negotiation/negotiator; approve/approval; inspect/inspection/inspector; supervise/supervision/supervisor; compensate/compensation; certify/certification/certificate. Existing family entries were retained; duplicate target words were not added.

### Synonym and CEFR case

Cambridge marks `competitor` as B1 and lists challenger/contender/rival as synonyms. Its record CEFR and sense CEFR were both updated from A2 to B1; `data/manifest.json` was updated to A1=64, A2=227, B1=276, B2=294, C1=67. No other CEFR labels were mass-changed.

## Automated verification

- All 3 `tools/patch-data.py` batches: dry-run PASS before apply.
- Data validator after batch and baseline tightening: 928 records, 0 ERROR, 12 legacy WARNING.
- Warnings remaining: DF005=3; EX006=1; FD001=8 violations across 7 records. No IPA warnings remain.
- Coverage: IPA=563/928 (61%); word_family=122/928 (13%); verb_forms=291/928; collocations=758/928; synonym-bearing records=361; antonym-bearing records=213. IPA remains blank on 365 records pending source review.
- CEFR word/sense mismatches: 0.
- ID count and ID-set SHA-256 remain 928 and `dd1705e64c8df4ad7ebca188a6ad856fff1d180d99730d2d77d2ba6fbdc12656`.

## Remaining work / caveats

- Continue IPA source work for the 365 remaining empty entries in small batches; do not auto-generate pronunciations.
- Continue synonym/antonym verification by sense and source; 312 of 763 unique lexical relations still lack a related-term gloss.
- Continue word-family coverage and targeted CEFR checking; do not mass-classify based solely on guessed level.
- Existing DF005/EX006/FD001 legacy warnings remain open for separate editorial correction.
- This batch does not change UI, Listening TTS, Smart Review, flashcard imagery, IndexedDB or personal learning data. Those requirements stay in v2.10.0.
- GitHub Actions, Pages deployment, iPhone Safari, Android Chrome and tablet/device QA are not verified by this local build.

### Competitive position — summary

The app's current differentiators are an owner-controlled, static GitHub Pages PWA; local/offline study data; source-traceable JSON updates; a single documented baseline; editable local TTS voice settings; and a clear content QA pipeline. Its current disadvantages versus specialist TOEIC products are much smaller content volume, no complete 100+100 question timed mock test, no official ETS audio/question bank, no psychometrically equated score, and no server-synced multi-device progress or AI tutor. See `docs/reports/TOEIC_APP_BENCHMARK_2026.md` for the sourced comparison.

## 1A. TOEIC acceptance gates — IELTS remains blocked until all pass

1. **Exam blueprint:** all 7 Parts have an explicit item-type schema and official-format target distribution: Listening P1=6, P2=25, P3=39, P4=30; Reading P5=30, P6=16, P7=54 (29 single-passage +25 multiple-passage). Total 200 questions; 45-minute Listening and 75-minute Reading practice timing. The IIBC reference describes approximately two hours and 200 questions. The official score scale is not to be imitated without validation.
2. **Content volume:** first-form minimum is now met in v2.12.0 (102 Listening / 109 Reading; includes the Part 7 split of at least 29 single-passage + 25 multiple-passage questions). This is only a pool-size gate, not approval to release a mock: finish semantic/editorial review, mock-engine QA and at least one complete 200-question form. Further work should add reserve content for repeatable/non-repeating forms.
3. **Listening quality:** all Parts 1–4; image/P1 material must be photo-realistic or explicitly labeled illustrative; Part 2 concise natural responses; Part 3 multi-speaker conversations; Part 4 short talks; transcripts, Vietnamese explanations, accent variety and playback review. TTS must not be described as recorded native-speaker/ETS audio.
4. **Reading quality:** Part 5 sentence completion; Part 6 text completion including sentence insertion where appropriate; Part 7 single/double/triple passages with linked questions and cross-document reasoning. Every item must have a unique answer key and reviewed rationale.
5. **Vocabulary quality:** target 3,000–5,000 TOEIC-priority headwords/lemmas as an internal planning target, not an ETS official list. Preserve IDs; attach sense-level meaning, POS, example + translation, topics, evidence/known source, review status; add IPA/family/relations only when verified. No forced completion of inapplicable fields.
6. **Grammar & strategy:** maintain a TOEIC grammar coverage matrix; map grammar topics into P5/P6 error patterns; avoid duplicate lessons and generic distractors.
7. **Practice and analytics:** review wrong answers, spaced repetition, bookmarks, adaptive part recommendations, per-Part accuracy and history; export/import remains local and testable.
8. **Mock engine:** timer, question navigation, flags, section boundaries, submission, answer review, analysis by Part and clear practice-only score estimation. Never label local estimates as an official ETS score.
9. **Release/QA:** validators, patch dry-run, tests, offline app-shell validation, desktop/tablet/iPhone/Android QA and export/import QA. Do not call Phase 5 complete until physical-device QA is recorded.
10. **Gate to IELTS:** all items above pass, at least one full 200-question mock is complete and reviewed, and user explicitly approves shifting scope. Until then IELTS remains deferred.

## 1B. Retained implementation baseline — v2.23.0 (cumulative updates recorded through v2.27.0)

- **Stable choice identity:** all Reading questions (109), Listening questions (113) and Grammar exercises (54) retain stable `choiceIds`; each identity moves with its option. Duplicate option text continues to use distinct IDs. The 11 new reserve questions also carry unique choice IDs.

New distributions are P3 A10/B10/C10/D9; P4 A8/B8/C7/D7; P7 A16/B16/C16/D15. Question IDs/order, passages/transcripts, explanations, all option text and keyed-answer text remain unchanged; only option position and `answerIndex` change.
- **v2.16 baseline snapshots:** each changed question includes `previousChoices`, `previousChoiceIds`, `previousAnswerIndex` and `choiceOrderRevision: "2.17.0"`. Exact old/new positions and answer text are recorded in `tools/answer-position-balance-v2.17.0.json` and `docs/batches/TOEIC_ANSWER_POSITION_BALANCE_BATCH_007_v2.17.0.md`. No random shuffling.
- **Progress migration hardening:** v2.16 progress with `choiceId` resolves the current index by identity and preserves the prior numeric position in `previousChoiceIndex`. Profiles without an ID use the saved v2.16 option snapshot on changed questions. Legacy distractors from the 12 v2.15 revisions retain separate archived IDs. Ambiguous stored text and invalid indices are not guessed/overwritten; the migration is idempotent across consecutive app starts.
- **History rendering:** wrong-answer highlighting resolves stable `choiceId` first, avoiding a stale-index highlight after reordering. Archived historical options remain displayed as archived rather than being misrepresented as a current option.
- **No schema reset:** IndexedDB remains database `toeic-vocabulary-phase1`, version 1, store `workspace`; no object-store/database-version change, progress reset or personal data deletion. Vocabulary remains 928 records, 928 stable IDs and 26 A–Z files. Listening 113, Reading 109 and Grammar 25 lessons /54 exercises are unchanged.
- **Current Listening inventory:** 63 units / 113 questions (P1=8, P2=30, P3=42, P4=33). The first-form selection remains 6/25/39/30; 13 Listening questions are additional practice/reserve beyond the 100-question Listening blueprint. Reading remains 109 and Grammar 54.
- **Part 1 media:** 8 Pexels photo paths plus source/license attribution are implemented. JPG is an OPTIONAL Service Worker cache asset and SVG is REQUIRED fallback. Missing OPTIONAL assets no longer fail the general structural validator; the strict `validate-part1-photo-assets.py` CI step still requires eight valid local JPEGs (1280×960 minimum). The current working copy has 0/8 JPG bytes, so the strict photo gate and image-level/offline photo QA remain pending. Do not replace missing photos with placeholders.
- **Reserve content — Batch 013:** Part 2 +5, Part 3 +3 and Part 4 +3 questions. The existing 132 reviewed Part 3/4/7 questions retain their certified distributions.
- **Listening/TTS playback — Batch 014 / v2.24.0:** manual male/female voice preferences, Daniel fallback, speaker mapping, rate and configured pauses are retained. `activeSpeechCancel` now settles the app-owned playback promise before browser cancellation, so a missing browser cancel callback cannot stall sequential dialogue/vocabulary playback. Expected canceled/interrupted preview events no longer show a false voice error. A deterministic mocked-SpeechSynthesis regression is registered in CI; it does not replace acoustic QA on actual devices.
- **Historical review registry:** 148 v2.19 reviewed questions are protected by per-question SHA-256 fingerprints plus per-unit content fingerprints for transcripts, segments, translations and source metadata, not one whole-file Listening hash. Five declared Part 1 wording alignments are allow-listed; unapproved changes to historical question or unit content remain test failures. Any new question outside the 148-item registry must be explicitly marked reserve-pending-independent-review. This fixes the known stale whole-file baseline collision caused by intentional Part 1 editorial updates and additive reserve questions.

## 1C. Next TOEIC-only development priorities after v2.28.0

1. **Expand TOEIC vocabulary first.** Preserve all 928 original baseline IDs plus 43 Batch 017 and 8 Batch 018 additions (979 current headwords) and existing personal word/progress data. Continue source-based batches toward the internal 3,000–5,000 headword target; prioritize practical workplace/business topics, sense-level examples, US IPA and collocation quality. Never invent IPA, CEFR, word families or lexical relations.
2. **Expand and strengthen Grammar.** Keep the existing Grammar module and question identity stable; add structured lessons/exercises with answer rationale and progressive difficulty. Avoid large redesigns while data is still being expanded.
3. **Add relevant decorative/study images.** Provide the user direct download links and an explicit approved filename plus destination folder for every asset (for example, under `assets/topics/` or a dedicated `assets/grammar/`/`assets/reading/` folder). Do not depend on decorative assets for core app startup; preserve the eight Part 1 JPGs and their SVG fallbacks.
4. **Extend Listening reserve.** First obtain independent review for all 11 Batch 013 reserve questions, then add new non-duplicate content by Part. Build enough extra Part 2/3/4 sets to create several distinct mock forms and avoid repeating the same Part 3/4 units. Add more P7 double/triple passages when the Reading phase resumes.
5. **Compare the app with current TOEIC learning platforms.** Research current, publicly available features, study paths, test engines, mock score reports, AI, audio, content scale, pricing and offline/data practices. Cite official product pages/recent sources and clearly distinguish observed features from estimates. Do this after the content priorities above, as requested.
6. **Mock Beta regression and real-device QA.** Verify 15/60/120-minute timers, answer navigation/flags, automatic Listening→Reading transition, refresh/resume, submissions, score/report review and PWA offline behavior. Check laptop at 100% zoom, tablet, iPhone Safari and Android Chrome. The current sandbox cannot establish physical audio/viewport signoff.
7. **Editorial and scoring boundary.** Internal second-pass coverage (211/211) is not independent expert or psychometric signoff. Mock reports show raw counts/accuracy and a 75% internal practice target; do not generate ETS 10–990 or CEFR claims without a trustworthy conversion/equating dataset and explicit labeling.
8. **Remote release verification.** Confirm GitHub Actions, Pages deployment/base path, service-worker update/offline behavior and strict Part 1 photo validation after the user applies the patch. The current local snapshot still lacks JPG bytes; remote images have not been read in this session.
9. **Personal IndexedDB profile QA (deferred).** Do not import/export/inspect/reset/migrate personal data unless the user explicitly requests it. Keep the IndexedDB schema and existing learning progress unchanged.

The next content sequence is explicitly: Vocabulary → Grammar → downloadable decorative image assets → reviewed Listening reserve → current TOEIC platform benchmark. IELTS remains excluded from data, lessons, filters and active roadmap until every TOEIC acceptance gate passes and the user explicitly approves the transition.

### Các quyết định đã thống nhất và cần giữ (theo kế hoạch Claude + ChatGPT đã được ghi nhận)

Các mục dưới đây được kế thừa từ kế hoạch đã thống nhất trước đây; lần cập nhật này không giả định đã có phiên trao đổi mới với Claude. Nếu có thay đổi, phải ghi decision và ngày phê duyệt trong Master trước khi sửa mã nguồn.

1. **Một Master duy nhất:** `docs/MASTER_STATUS.md` là nguồn sự thật về phạm vi, tiến độ, quyết định và roadmap. Không tạo master/roadmap/data-guide thứ hai.
2. **GitHub Pages-only:** giữ triển khai tĩnh + PWA; không thêm backend, Cloudflare hay dịch vụ ngoài nếu chưa có yêu cầu mới. Dữ liệu cá nhân lưu trên thiết bị.
3. **Không làm mất dữ liệu:** giữ 928 stable IDs, không xóa/đổi ID khi biên tập; base vocabulary read-only trong UI; dữ liệu cá nhân không ghi ngược vào JSON gốc.
4. **Không bịa dữ liệu để lấp trường:** IPA, CEFR, word family, verb forms, collocations, synonyms/antonyms phải có căn cứ theo POS/sense và nguồn. Trường không áp dụng hoặc chưa chắc phải để trống có chủ đích.
5. **Batch nhỏ, có khóa:** dùng patch `baseDataVersion`, SHA-256 ID set, stable ID, `expect.old`; dry-run trước apply; chạy validator và báo cáo before/after. Không mass reclassification.
6. **TOEIC-only until acceptance:** tập trung 100% vào TOEIC Listening & Reading; chưa đưa IELTS/Academic vào dữ liệu, UI, bộ lọc, lộ trình hoặc batch nội dung. Chỉ mở IELTS sau khi đạt các cổng nghiệm thu TOEIC được ghi trong Master. Mục tiêu 3.000–5.000 TOEIC headwords/lemma là mốc quản trị, không phải danh sách chính thức của ETS.
7. **Tách loại đơn vị:** headword/lemma, sense, word family, phrasal verb, idiom và collocation không cộng gộp thành một con số “từ vựng”.
8. **Phase 5 trước Phase 6:** hoàn thiện chất lượng dữ liệu, các module học tập và QA thực tế trước khi xây Full Mock Test 200 câu.
9. **TTS phụ thuộc thiết bị:** app chỉ chọn voice browser/OS cung cấp; không khẳng định khử ồn hoặc chất lượng premium khi không có; giữ lựa chọn thủ công ưu tiên cao hơn fallback Daniel.
10. **Bàn giao trung thực:** không ghi deploy/commit/CI/thiết bị đã PASS nếu chưa có bằng chứng thao tác trực tiếp.

### Thứ tự triển khai được giữ

- **Nhánh 2.10.x — hoàn thiện dữ liệu:** tiếp tục IPA có nguồn → Word Family theo quan hệ hình thái → synonyms/antonyms + related gloss theo sense → CEFR và nguồn → mở rộng headwords TOEIC theo ma trận. Mỗi batch chỉ xử lý nhóm nhỏ, không đổi ID.
- **Phase 5E — Listening:** bổ sung Part 1 bằng ảnh và câu mô tả; sau đó tăng dần Part 2–4, hội thoại 2–3 người, short talks, transcript, bản dịch, câu hỏi và QA TTS trên thiết bị.
- **Phase 5F — Reading & Grammar:** chuẩn hóa `documentType`, mở rộng độ dài/loại văn bản và câu hỏi; lập ma trận Grammar cơ bản → nâng cao.
- **Phase 5H — QA & phát hành:** desktop/laptop, tablet, iPhone Safari, Android Chrome; PWA install/offline/cache; IndexedDB/export/import; sau đó mới đánh dấu Phase 5 DONE.
- **Phase 6 — Full Mock Test:** khung thi thử 7 Parts / 200 câu, timer, điều hướng, đánh dấu, nộp bài, giải thích, phân tích theo Part; điểm quy đổi chỉ là ước lượng học tập.

### Quy ước quản lý tài liệu

- `docs/MASTER_STATUS.md`: cập nhật bảng workstream, số liệu, blockers và next actions sau mỗi batch/release.
- `docs/batches/`: báo cáo phạm vi/ID/bản ghi đã xử lý của từng batch.
- `docs/reports/`: test report, audit và QA.
- `docs/sources/`: nguồn tham khảo và phương pháp biên tập.
- `docs/README.md`: chỉ mục tài liệu và cách chạy thử/triển khai.
- `docs/CHANGELOG.md`: nhật ký phiên bản. Mọi Markdown mới phải đặt đúng folder; không rải `.md` ở root.

## 1. Kết luận hiện tại

**Giai đoạn hiện tại: TOEIC-only Phase 5 — hoàn tất hai vòng rà soát nội bộ toàn bộ 211 câu Listening/Reading, tiếp tục QA giao diện và độ phủ nội dung. Phase 6 (Full Mock 200 câu) chỉ bắt đầu khi có rà soát độc lập và QA nền tảng đạt cổng nghiệm thu. IELTS đang bị khóa phạm vi.**

Nền tảng ứng dụng, từ điển A–Z, ôn tập, flashcard, Grammar, Reading, Listening, PWA và lưu dữ liệu cục bộ đã có mã nguồn. Việc còn thiếu lớn nhất không phải thêm nhiều màn hình mới, mà là:

1. Làm giàu và kiểm chứng dữ liệu từ vựng hiện có.
2. Bổ sung hình minh họa riêng cho từng từ và nội dung nghe/đọc có chiều sâu.
3. Hoàn thiện Listening theo cấu trúc đủ Part, hội thoại tự nhiên và chất lượng giọng trên thiết bị thật.
4. Rà soát nguồn của các dạng bất quy tắc/ngoại lệ còn lại; hoàn thiện word family, IPA và quan hệ từ.
5. Kiểm thử toàn bộ luồng học tập trên desktop, tablet, iPhone và Android trước khi mở rộng sang Full Mock Test.

**Số liệu dữ liệu tại baseline v2.10.2 (trước v2.11.0):** 928 bản ghi trong 26 tệp A–Z; 32 chủ đề; CEFR A1=64, A2=227, B1=276, B2=294, C1=67 (ước lượng biên tập; riêng `competitor` được Cambridge xác nhận B1). Validator: 0 ERROR, 12 WARNING legacy (DF005=3, EX006=1, FD001=8 vi phạm/7 hồ sơ). IPA=574/928; `word_family`=131/928; synonyms=361 hồ sơ, antonyms=213; verb_forms=291, collocations=758. ID set giữ nguyên. v2.10.2 không thêm nợ validator mới.

> Đính chính kiểm toán lịch sử (06/11/2026): ZIP v2.9.0 có 577 bản ghi; ZIP v2.9.2 chỉ còn 492. Đối chiếu theo `word ID` xác nhận 85 bản ghi đã mất; đã khôi phục đủ 85 bản ghi. Đây là mốc phục hồi lịch sử v2.9.2, không phải tổng hiện tại: các Batch 001–005 sau đó nâng dữ liệu lên 928 bản ghi.

## 2. Phạm vi sản phẩm đã thống nhất

- Từ điển TOEIC A–Z, tìm kiếm và lọc theo chữ cái/chủ đề/loại từ/CEFR.
- Phân nhóm từ vựng theo chủ đề; mở rộng từ cơ bản đến nâng cao, có mức CEFR và độ khó tham khảo.
- Ôn tập thông minh: câu hỏi ngẫu nhiên, điền chữ còn thiếu, nghĩa → từ, từ → nghĩa, loại từ, đồng nghĩa/trái nghĩa và dạng động từ.
- Flashcard thân thiện với người học trẻ: hình minh họa, từ, phát âm, nghĩa, cách dùng và ví dụ; học theo lượt 10 từ, kiểm tra nhanh, trộn từ sai với từ mới.
- Grammar: cấu trúc câu, điểm ngữ pháp, ví dụ và bài tập tách bạch câu hỏi/đáp án/giải thích.
- Reading: email, thư, thông báo, quảng cáo tuyển dụng, lịch trình, văn bản đơn/đôi/ba và câu hỏi đọc hiểu.
- Listening: Part 1–4, audio/hội thoại, nhiều người nói, câu hỏi, transcript và giải thích.
- Nhắc học theo chu kỳ 60/90/120/180 phút.
- Từ cá nhân có thể thêm/sửa/ẩn/xóa; dữ liệu từ điển gốc chỉ đọc.
- Google AI theo cơ chế prompt một chiều: tạo prompt trong app rồi mở Google AI Mode bên ngoài.
- Giao diện responsive desktop/tablet/mobile, PWA và khả năng dùng offline với app shell/dữ liệu đã cache.
- Tiến độ, từ cá nhân và cài đặt được lưu trên thiết bị; có Export/Import để sao lưu/chuyển thiết bị.
- Footer ghi nhận tác giả: **Vũ Nguyễn Hoàng Phúc**.
